Message #41 Ch 1 - Kirkilston by 396686 Dungeon Master (GM) Tue, 19 May 2026 21:47:43 GMT If it's easier to think in old-school terms, Steve, the boar's THAC0 is 18 and it's AC is 8. Message #42 Ch 1 - Kirkilston by 396653 Jelb Garrick Tue, 19 May 2026 23:57:47 GMT Jelb bade his brother farewell, assuring him that he'd bring back some stories for him. He called Melbor and Kaybar to heel as they headed out. --- He made small talk with the group as they went along, trying to get to know who he was working with a bit more. When the boar appeared, Jelb hesitated for a long moment. When it attacked Kelpie, Jelb drew back and away from it. As he did, he uttered what he hoped would prove to be magic words. Pointing at the boar, he called: "Melbor. Kaybar. Crash." The two hunting dogs leapt to the prey. Jelb meanwhile prayed that they would at least last long enough to prevent a loss of human life. OOC: 19:56, Today: Jelb Garrick rolled 13,5 using 1d20+1,1d6. Kaybar attack. 19:56, Today: Jelb Garrick rolled 14,3 using 1d20+1,1d6. Melbor attack. I'm happy to Chronicle. Will be on vacation for a week or so, so my posts may be a bit spotty until I'm back full time. Message #43 Ch 1 - Kirkilston by 396686 Dungeon Master (GM) Wed, 20 May 2026 00:24:09 GMT Sounds good, Jelb is the Chronicler. Both dogs hit, ripping flesh with their attacks. The wild boar is down to 1 hp. Message #44 Ch 1 - Kirkilston by 396652 Urvan Hall Wed, 20 May 2026 00:31:34 GMT Urvan proved a little quiet at first on the road, although he seemed good natured and appreciative of Kelpie's assurances. What occupied his thoughts as they hiked along was difficult to tell at a mere glance. --- Although the young man was clearly inexperienced, it seemed that he had some descent instruction at some point within his Order. With the head of his mace resting upon his shoulder, he led with his shield in a somewhat crouched stance, then working in conjunction with the others, he hefted the weapon high and swing in with an audible woosh , the small iron head a blur as it arced through the air towards the swine. 12 to hit with 7 damage if it does Message #45 Ch 1 - Kirkilston by 396686 Dungeon Master (GM) Wed, 20 May 2026 02:24:22 GMT And Urvan lands the killing blow! You have a freshly killed wild boar, about six hundred pounds. It's good eating, if you know how to prepare it. You have slain it just as Sunrise Watch reaches its midpoint. If you press onward, you can be at Nuanda's Hut within the half-hour. If you stay to field dress the hog, it'll take two hours with all of you working together. Message #46 Ch 1 - Kirkilston by 396648 Kelpie Lawfuller Fighter 1, AC 2, HP 7/7 Wed, 20 May 2026 06:19:14 GMT The melee ended as quickly as it had begun. The savage boar lay still, brought down by the dogs fury and the crushing weight of Urvan's mace. Kelpie paused to catch his breath, then crouched beside the carcass. Up close, the beast was enormous far too heavy to haul any real distance. Penniless as he was, Kelpie felt the tug of practicality. There was value here, if they were wise about it. But another thought pressed harder: "We must press on to the good witch," he reminded the others. "Every moment wasted leaves poor Jenny in more peril." He stretched his shoulders, then set the tip of his sword against the boar's flank. "still, perhaps we take the best bits as a gift for Nuanda." He marked the line between shoulder and thigh with the flat of his blade. "Its' not far, and we can manage this much between us." With a grunt, Kelpie lifted his sword and brought it down, severing the boars feet. He tossed them aside for the dogs. "Melbor! Kaybar!" he called, letting the hounds feast while he looked to the others for agreement. OOC A 600 lb boar = roughly 6000 coins encumbrance. Kelpie and Urvan can each carry about 800 coins, Jelb a bit more. So hauling the whole carcass isnt feasible. My suggestion: Cut off the best section (shoulder to thigh) Leave the rest for the crows and wolves Press on quickly to the witch Offer the boar meat as a gift/payment for information or aid Message #47 Ch 1 - Kirkilston by 396652 Urvan Hall Wed, 20 May 2026 14:04:28 GMT "A sound plan," Urvan agreed as he caught his breath as he slipped the haft of his mace back into the ring at his belt, letting the weapon slide home with a small metallic sound. "I've no knife with which to help butcher, but will help where I can of course," he offered as he shrugged out of his pack and began top shrug off his tabard to assist. Message #48 Ch 1 - Kirkilston by 396653 Jelb Garrick Wed, 20 May 2026 16:34:20 GMT Jelb drew a dagger for himself, then passed the other man his second dagger still in its sheathe. "Keep it. You never know when you might need one," He remarked, then set to helping cut off some of the meat. Once they had taken what they could quickly and while staying clear of the viscera, he wiped his dagger and put it away. Message #49 Ch 1 - Kirkilston by 396648 Kelpie Lawfuller Fighter 1, AC 2, HP 7/7 Wed, 20 May 2026 20:13:12 GMT With their plan agreed, Kelpie set to work. He braced the carcass and used his sword to help with the quick butchery, carving away the chosen cuts with steady, deliberate strokes. When the work was done, he wiped the blade clean on the boar's hide, slid it back into its sheath, and hefted his pack onto his shoulders. Without fuss or flourish, he stepped to the front of the group once more. Kelpie gave a short nod. "Right, then. Let's be on our way." And with that, he led them onward toward Nuanda. OOC: Onward to the good witch once the butchery is wrapped up. Message #50 Ch 1 - Kirkilston by 396686 Dungeon Master (GM) Wed, 20 May 2026 22:40:33 GMT As the adventurers crest a rise in the fog-laden forest, their eyes fall upon a crooked, moss-covered cottage that seems half-swallowed by brambles and twisted black branches. Its sagging roof is shingled with dark, weathered wood, and a thin column of smoke curls from a stone chimney, promising both warmth and a watchful inhabitant. Herbs, dried flowers, and small charms dangle from the eaves and across the doorway, interspersed with skulls and bones, giving the place an unsettling yet deliberate artistry. A narrow, muddy path winds past scattered feathers and wild lavender, leading to a low, crooked fence of spiked, blackened branches. On the porch and along rough-hewn tables, a blackthorn wand rests within reach, an iron dagger and bone-handled ritual knife lie beside bundles of dried herbs, and a small mirror of polished black glass catches the dim light. A witch-bottle containing hair, pins, and ash hangs by the threshold. Just within the doorway, a pale woman with dark, layered robes and sharp gray eyes peers out, her fingers streaked with ink and ash, exuding a calm, watchful presence. The whole scene suggests bargains struck in whispers, secrets kept, and knowledge both forbidden and potent, a home as alive with hidden power as its enigmatic occupant. The woman speaks to her cat, though you're still too distant to hear her words; then the woman smiles at you from a distance, turns, and enters her cottage. As you draw nearer, the black cat steps onto the game-path that leads to the cottage. It's green eyes shine in the morning sunlight that filters down through the forest eaves. He boldly approaches Kelpie then meows and rubs itself against one of the fighter's tough leather boots -- all the while checking out Jelb and Urvan. After Kelpie tosses it a piece of meat, the cat meanders back toward the cozy cottage, seeming satisfied with both the snack and with the guests. This message was last edited by the GM at 17:54, Thu 21 May. Message #51 Ch 1 - Kirkilston by 396652 Urvan Hall Thur, 21 May 2026 04:22:18 GMT Urvan lingered for a time perhaps fifty paces from the home and took the moment to sip water from his skin. His recent childhood had been a world of straight lines and swept spaces, of the sound of low sonorous chants and the clear ring of a bell. This moss covered cottage was an antithesis of sorts, all soft curves and dabbled greens and browns. It was not unpleasant, not at all really, but it was very, very different . He was not quite sure how to feel about it, and this made him uncomfortable. As they neared his blue eyes roved over the baubles and curiosities, his hesitant curiosity plain as he had removed his kettle hat as they approached the home out of a sense of politeness. "What a curious place..." Urvan half whispered, his tone wary and soft, as if he was still making up his mind. Message #52 Ch 1 - Kirkilston by 396648 Kelpie Lawfuller Fighter 1, AC 2, HP 7/7 Thur, 21 May 2026 06:39:12 GMT It was a relief to reach their destination without further surprises. Emboldened by the black cats friendly welcome, Kelpie followed Nuanda into her cottage. As he crossed the threshold, he murmured a quiet prayer under his breath. From toil springs the safety and just rewards in later seasons. His shoulders eased as he set down the heavy pack, grateful to be rid of its weight. Following Urvan's example, he removed his sallet and held it respectfully at his side. "Good witch, Nuanda, I am Kelpie, and these are my companions, Urvan and Jelb," Kelpie began, bowing his head slightly. "we seek your aid and wisdom. We bring fresh meat in trade," he gestured to the bundled cuts of boar, then offered a broad, toothless smile. "Our purpose is to find the missing girl, Jelenth." The words were simple, but the earnestness behind them was unmistakable. Message #53 Ch 1 - Kirkilston by 396686 Dungeon Master (GM) Fri, 22 May 2026 01:37:56 GMT nuanda.webp"Welcome, travelers. I am Nuanda, whom you seek. I am heating water for a stew, since I saw you slay the boar and butcher it. Please, that knife on the kitchen counter. Would you be a dear," she says, looking at Urvan a bit coquettishly, "and dice the meat into small cubes? Thank you, Bannerman. And you, warrior, would you cut up potatoes?" She turns to Jelb. "Would you mind kneading this dough while I go and draw water from the well?" She seems to see the urgency in your eyes. "Yes, I heard you, and I will help you with your mission. But it will require strength. We must eat first." This message was last edited by the GM at 20:47, Thu 21 May. Message #54 Ch 1 - Kirkilston by 396653 Jelb Garrick Fri, 22 May 2026 01:51:56 GMT Jelb kept his counsel mostly to himself. He hadn't known Nuanda personally until now, but had heard rumors. Healer. Witch. Enchantress. Helper. Blood sorceress. Much the same as passed around about him when people didn't know he could hear. Nevertheless, he was not a strong mage by any standard, and by all accounts she had significant power for good or for ill. So he hoped and prayed for the best but kept his eyes carefully open for indication of the opposite. Message #55 Ch 1 - Kirkilston by 396652 Urvan Hall Fri, 22 May 2026 03:36:02 GMT Urvan did not seem to be expecting the welcome, the request, or the way it was delivered. The Squire seemed to almost blush faintly before he nodded. "Uh...yes, of course," he agreed before he took a cut of the fresh pork, laid it out upon a fitting surface and began to cube the meat with the dagger that Jelb had been kind enough to give him. While no real cook, he at the very least could carry out this simple task without issue and was soon working diligently while occasionally sparing a glance to their hostess and her home. Message #56 Ch 1 - Kirkilston by 396648 Kelpie Lawfuller Fighter 1, AC 2, HP 7/7 Fri, 22 May 2026 06:27:03 GMT Where others might have baulked at such easy familiarity with a witch or with simple country folk Kelpie felt entirely at home. He'd earned his keep in many ways over the years, chopping wood, mending fences, hauling water, guarding doors, and sometimes even earning a few coins for his trouble. Hospitality was a language he understood. He was quietly grateful that Nuanda planned to make a stew. Roast meat would have been a long, tedious affair for a man with no teeth; stew was a blessing. In the small cottage they would all be close together, working shoulder to shoulder. Kelpie gave his broad, toothless smile. "Aye," he said, accepting his duty to cut the potatoes. "Give me a moment." He followed Nuanda outside, watching her draw water from the well as he began stripping off his armour piece by piece. The fresh air and the relief of shedding the weight made him sigh. The Darkwood - "Tis a dangerous place for a person alone," he remarked, half statement, half gentle question. Once unburdened, he returned to the warmth of the cottage kitchen, ready to work alongside the others. He took up a knife and set to cutting potatoes with steady, deliberate strokes, content in the simple labour. Message #57 Ch 1 - Kirkilston by Nuanda () Fri, 22 May 2026 23:48:39 GMT nuanda.webpPulling up a bucket of water from the well, Nuanda replies to Kelpie's observation. "Aye, there are dangers, but I have Morrow to protect me, and of course my own ways and wiles." She follows Kelpie back into the cottage, where she adds more water to the stewpot. Casting a quick glance at Jelb and Urvan's progress in preparing a meal, she says, "So, you seek someone, and wish my aid in finding them?" Message #58 Ch 1 - Kirkilston by 396648 Kelpie Lawfuller Fighter 1, AC 2, HP 7/7 Sat, 23 May 2026 06:20:54 GMT Settled into the simple rhythm of preparing a meal and freed of his armour Kelpie looked for all the world like any other farmer or village hand. Bald head, gummy smile, sleeves rolled up, he was entirely at ease. He worked steadily, cutting potatoes with the quiet contentment of a man who knew honest labour. But at the reminder of why they were here, his mood shifted. His hands slowed, the knife resting a moment on the chopping board as he let out a soft sigh. Then, with a small nod to himself, he resumed his work. "It's the girl, Jelenneth - from the Heldrith farm," he said, voice low but steady. He shrugged, a gesture of simple truth rather than indifference. "She's been missin more'n a week, now. We seek to return her home." He paused, the knife stilling again for a heartbeat. "Or at least let her family know what's befallen her." Pragmatic words, but spoken with a quiet weight that showed how deeply he meant them. Message #59 Ch 1 - Kirkilston by 396686 Dungeon Master (GM) Sat, 23 May 2026 15:45:37 GMT nuanda.webp"I see. Where is she from, and do you have anything that belongs to her? A brush? A necklace? If not, it simply becomes more difficult, but not impossible, to help you. You have no relation to this missing girl?" Message #60 Ch 1 - Kirkilston by 396648 Kelpie Lawfuller Fighter 1, AC 2, HP 7/7 Sat, 23 May 2026 21:41:15 GMT "No relation of mine just neighbourly, helping those in need," Kelpie replied to the good witch. He paused in his potato cutting, wiping his hands on his trousers before continuing. "Jelenneth, she's the daughter of Farmer Heldrith and Parker Laneworth. Their farm's north of Kirkliston," he gave a small shrug, more thoughtful than dismissive. I'm guessing either somethin' happened on the road, or she wandered into the woods north o' here." Kelpie's brow furrowed as he considered the possibilities. "Thing is, if she came into these woods, or if some evil's lurkin' in 'em, I reckoned you'd know." He lifted his gaze to Nuanda, his tone respectful, almost reverent. "If ye don't mind me sayin' so, folk speak of ye havin' the gift, as it were." His toothless smile softened the words, making them earnest rather than flattering. Message #61 Ch 1 - Kirkilston by 396686 Dungeon Master (GM) Sun, 24 May 2026 00:18:00 GMT Please continue by switching to the Chapter 2 thread.

pages.title: Chapter 2 Supper with Nuanda
pages.content: Message #1 Ch 2 - Supper With Nuanda by 396686 Dungeon Master (GM) Soon, all the ingredients for the stew are bubbling over a fire in Nuanda's fireplace. The iron pot has a two-gallon capacity and is filled 3/4 of the way to the top. Nuanda has just diced upon onions, celery, and some tomatoes and added them and a sprig of garlic to the pot. She checks the baking bread, then sits in a rickety but comfortable looking rocking chair. "Another couple hours for the stew, but the bread will be ready soon and I have butter from Kirkilston." She gestures to Urvan, then points to a large flagstone, one of many forming her floor. Sir, would you be so kind as to lift that stone?" When the paladin does so the party sees a stone-lined rectangular column of open air going down beneath the floor perhaps a full ten feet. A rope tied to an iron hook six inches beneath the floor is obviously for the purpose of raising and lowering a wooden 2' x 2' platform. "A freshwater spring flows beneath the cottage. I use it to keep certain things cool: butter, pickled eggs, even sometimes leftovers. Would you be a dear and hoist that up so I can get the butter? Jelb, would you check the baking bread in the oven?" Soon, the four of your are sitting and eating delicious sourdough bread slathered with cool, salted butter. You pass around a bottle of chilled wine (which Urvan also hoisted up from below), a vintage that Nuanda claims comes from a special friend . "I of course don't expect you to drink, Urvan. I understand your order's prohibition against alcohol, but perhaps Kelpie and Jelb would enjoy some fruit of the vine?" Message #2 Ch 2 - Supper With Nuanda by 396653 Jelb Garrick Jelb agreed to check on the bread, bringing it out to cool when it was ready. "I do have something of hers. Her brother gave me a glove of hers, hoping I could set my dogs to tracking her by it. My dogs were trained for game, not people, but I promised him I'd try it if we failed to find other leads. I hadn't the hear to do otherwise." He hesitated a moment about actually consuming anything. The woman seemed sincere, and even a fiend would draw back before violating hospitality... he hoped. So, fortifying his courage he accepted her hospitality via the bread and a small drink of the wine and hoped to prove her goodness. Message #3 Ch 2 - Supper With Nuanda by 396686 Dungeon Master (GM) nuanda.webp "Oh, Jelb, that was well done!" Nuanda takes the glove, a sparkle in her eyes. "Yes, with this I can get a much better idea of the girl's location. It will require me entering the Dream World tonight. Can the three of you spend the night? I will know more in the morning. But this will make my efforts much easier!" Nuanda ladles stew into deep wooden bowls and hands out wooden spoons. The aroma of the stew is rich, meaty, and with a hint of garlic. Fully half of the loaf of bread remains, and she cuts thick slabs of it for each of you. "Tell me more about yourselves, your pasts. I would hear of your hopes and aspirations, and also crave news of the outside world. I have few friends there, and many of them I have not seen in quite some time." This message was last edited by the GM at 09:13, Sun 24 May. Message #4 Ch 2 - Supper With Nuanda by 396652 Urvan Hall Urvan handled the bottle of wine gingerly, almost as if he were hesitant to touch it, but settled in for the meal with a polite smile and just a little too much formality. It was clear he did not know quite how to act with Nuanda despite their Witch Hunter's assurances, and so he defaulted to a sort of mild official posture, cordial but not exactly warm. He nodded in agreement at Jelb's good foresight, but when it began time for dinner conversation he seemed to struggle a little as the bread was sliced up. "I'm afraid I have little news to share." he told her honestly. "I have the good fortune to be squired to a Sir Chevae Thrace and have been living in Eastdale in his service for some years." he explained. "Where one might imagine tournaments or...tax collection when knighthood is mentioned, our duties are understandably more theocratic in nature, and I support Sir Thrace and the other Paladins where I can in duties that cannot be entrusted to a novitiate" he seemed to search for words for a brief moment. "Most of the reports he is called upon to investigate are merely youth dabbling with what they think may be the dark arts, or just trying to impress their peers or upset their parents, but there have been a few genuine cases that I have borne witness to during my training." he admitted before he asked in turn. "You seem to have earned the respect of the locals...no mean feat." he told her before he began to eat. Message #5 Ch 2 - Supper With Nuanda by 396686 Dungeon Master (GM) nuanda.webp"Oh, I don't know about 'respect'; maybe a few actually feel that; for most the truth is probably closer to wariness. It is true there aren't many white witches. In fact, I know of only one other besides me." Nuanda sips wine, then decides on another slice of bread. Outside, darkness is falling. "You Red Bannermen are right to go after black witches; they draw power from different sources, but always they are powers harmful to nature and bent upon destruction, domination. That is not the way. Demetra teaches that if we care for the world and work hard for its prosperity, it will in turn take care of each of us." Nuanda notices Kelpie's suddenly sharpened interest. "Yes, I venerate Demetra. At one time, I sought to enter her priesthood, but the Prelate learned whose daughter I am, and that was that. He wouldn't hear of the daughter of Vinuvia joining any good-aligned religion in the Middenmark. I was judged for the sins of my mother." She turns to regard Urvan. "I have met your liege, Sir Chevae. He came here six years ago, after my mother killed his younger brother, Fingal. He was certainly ... conflicted, but I must say he acted honorably. He explained that St. Ygg had revealed to him that I was unlike the other witches. Did you know he'd been sent to slay me, and did not carry out the order?" Message #6 Ch 2 - Supper With Nuanda by 396653 Jelb Garrick Jelb held his peace while Urvan and Nuanda talked. --- When their conversation wound down, Jelb spoke of himself a bit. "I've always had respect for the goodly gods that have held the line against the wicked and I believe most need laws to keep the morally challenged at bay. But hidebound adherence to rules can lead to a bleakness all its own. Where's the excitement if everything always goes as planned? I seek a god who does what is good for others, but doesn't mind upsetting the applecart to wake people out of a stupor, or to test the righteous and proce them true... but who never causes harm to the innocent without bringing a blessing that exceeds it." He hesitated for a long moment, then confided. "And in my most insane dreams... if I can't find him, I will upset apple carts and bring joy and wakefulness to people until I become him." Message #7 Ch 2 - Supper With Nuanda by 396648 Kelpie Lawfuller Thank Demetra for this food Kelpie murmured, offering a quiet prayer as the bread was shared in simple hospitality. Not wanting to seem discourteous, he accepted the wine as well. Toothless, he sucked at the bread and chewed slowly, content in the small pleasure of eating among friends. He listened while Jelb, Nuanda, and Urvan spoke, nodding along as the conversation flowed. When the soup was ready, he slurped the broth with open delight. Once his belly was full, he wiped his chin with the back of his hand and smiled. Like my father before me, I travel the road in search o work he said, settling into the tale as naturally as breathing some call me sellsword¦ those more courteous say hedge knight he left it to them to decide which fit. My father taught me that honour is a true mans armour. He always helped those in need. Whether they could pay or not. Loyal to those he served, and grateful for every hearth that gave warmth. He thanked Demetra for the harvest, and for the good folk who tended it. Kelpie touched his brow, then his heart my pas memory sits her and here. I try to honour it. I was his squire, and when he passed, I took up his sword to follow in his bootsteps. he stretched his legs beneath the table, easing the stiffness from sitting since then I've walked the road, fought when fightin was needed, laboured when work was required. A simple life but its the only one Ive known these many years. Message #8 Ch 2 - Supper With Nuanda by 396686 Dungeon Master (GM) Nuanda's eye dilate momentarily at the proclamation Jelb makes at the end of his dialogue, then her equanimity returns. And as Kelpie describes his life, she cocks her head in reverie, listening intently. She does not fail to mark that the Excoriator doesn't remark upon the consumption of wine. After the supper is cleared away (Nuanda leaves the stew warming over a bed of hot coals), she produces sturdy but lightweight wooden cots made of oak, some canvas-like material, and cord. "Do any of you need to relieve yourselves outside before I set my evening wards and alarums?" Message #9 Ch 2 - Supper With Nuanda by 396652 Urvan Hall By Urvan's expression he had clearly been told little or nothing about what had happened to his Knight's brother, or their hosts lineage. He shifted a little in his seat and cleared his throat before he spoke again. "No, that has yet to come up. I can only guess that he prefers not to speak of his loss, or of the...difficulties of his assignment" he replied seriously, and seemed to be processing this new information as the others spoke. He listened with interest as he learned more about those he travelled with, although he did seem a little distracted. By the time the meal was winding down he seemed pensive, and declined the invitation to relief himself before they bedded down for the evening. Message #10 Ch 2 - Supper With Nuanda by Nuanda () "Morovar, comar ad momar, meon sweetor petor!" Nuanda calls. Her black cat comes bounding into the room from the small kitchen and leaps onto the witch's lap. Nuanda then strokes her pet behind each ear. "Morovar, maintainum guardor utside. Mone elv ad anyar potentialion threatorir." And away bounds Morrow, leaping through the partially opened kitchen window into the dark night. Nuanda dips her finger into a small glass jar that she produces from her robe, then wipes gray ash over the fireplace, and over the kitchen window, and on the closed cottage door. She intones, "Spiritir de il Albael, audite meon vocael! Descende super hicar habitaculon. Custodi id contra malum." She turns to the three of you. "I will retire early tonight, to enter the Somnion Mundar, while wearing Jelenneth's glove. I will have answers, or at least some idea of where to find them, by morning. But please, you three finish off the bread, converse. It will not interrupt me. If you were to need me -- and that is not likely -- then you must shout, 'Nuanda, returnum ex Shadowor ad tuon carnaleivos. Tu sunt relequai!' Can you repeat it back to me? This is important." Message #11 Ch 2 - Supper With Nuanda by 396653 Jelb Garrick Jelb listened and watched very carefully, seeking fully to understand what Nuanda was doing, both in her wards and the words she was teaching them. Well, as fully as an inexperienced mage of a different tradition and lineage could, anyways. When she asked them to repeat her phrase, he thought for only a moment before intoning a reasonable facsimile of what she had said, Nuanda, returnum ex Shadowor ad tuon carnaleivos. Tu sunt relequai! He made the sounds blandly, as he had learned to do with new spells, keeping his intentions and desires out of it and focusing purely on the phonetics. "Are the words alone required, or is the... He had been about to ask whether they needed intent with it, but he don't any of them - himself included - would be able to pronounce the words in a desperate situation without deeply desiring for her whole self to be present. So whether they should focus on a mind, body, or sprit returning to them was moot. "Nevermind - got that part. Will you be traveling in mind, body, or spirit, or will the revelations be coming to you by absorbing your attention?" He asked instead. Message #12 Ch 2 - Supper With Nuanda by 396648 Kelpie Lawfuller By the hearth, Kelpie felt safe, wrapped in warmth, good company, and the honest comfort of a roof overhead. But when he witnessed magic at work, a tingle crept down his spine. Magic was a strange thing to him: powerful, unpredictable, and far beyond his understanding. Best handled by others. So when Jelb spoke the arcane words, Kelpie let out a quiet breath of relief. He would not need to remember them, nor attempt such things himself. He nodded along as the others discussed the spells meaning, not grasping the workings of it, but recognising its importance all the same. The days weight settled on him then, and he decided it was best to rest while he could. Whatever tomorrow held, he would meet it with a clear head and steady hands. With the cot provided, he eased himself down. A bed, any bed, was a blessing. Far better than a hedge, and more comfort than hed known in many a night. Message #13 Ch 2 - Supper With Nuanda by 396652 Urvan Hall Urvan nodded a little, perhaps in thanks, at Jelbs deft repetition of Nuanda's instructions. Not knowing the words themselves he privately felt that he could not in good faith repeat them, and he had already strived to be a polite guest in the service of hopefully finding the lost girl and returning her to her family. The complexities of what their hostess were about to undertake were lost upon him, but he paid close attention all the same. It was his role, in a way, to learn these things so that he might find hints of them elsewhere in the form of the craft's darker mirror, and he focused upon absorbing and retaining this unique experience, one that most of his peers might never obtain. Although his mentor had been here apparently, and on important business. That thought stayed with him even as he prepared to bed down for the evening. Message #14 Ch 2 - Supper With Nuanda by Nuanda () The night passes without incident, and as morning light begins to filter into the cottage, the sounds of forest insects reach your ears. As Jelb pores over his spellbook and Urvan prays, Nuanda makes biscuits and a thick white gravy with spicy sausage in it. She pushes the first plate in front of Kelpie as he busies himself cleaning his equipment. "Dig in! she encourages, then serves up a plate each for Urvan and Jelb. She places a big bowl of blueberries in the center of the table, and a jug of chilled cider next to it. "Demetra, we give thanks for this thy bounty." Morrow has entered through the kitchen window and proudly presents the fruits of his morning hunt, a plump mouse. "I have information for you. Valuable information. I am going to give it to you regardless, but I would be obliged if you'd take upon yourself a small quest on my behalf..." This message was last updated by the GM at 18:38, Tue 26 May. Message #15 Ch 2 - Supper With Nuanda by 396653 Jelb Garrick Jelb looks slightly shocked at the appearance of the cat and its prey, then averted his eyes quickly. He looked deeply distracted for a long moment before nodding his head and apparently re-running what Nuanda had said through his mind and answering, "I can't imagine that any of us wouldn't at least consider a quest on your behalf, for your hospitality alone, not even counting any aid given to finding the young lady," He said seriously, wondering what she had in mind... but not letting his curiosity keep him from setting to the breakfast. Message #16 Ch 2 - Supper With Nuanda by Nuanda () "The girl, Jelenneth. She was picking berries at the edge of her family's property one morning when bandits abducted her. Kicking and screaming, she was conveyed northward. I was able to communicate with an ally of mine, a ranger named Kuiper who ranges the wilds from Raven's Pass to Threshold, and from Slaytonthorpe to the Coal Hills. He has gotten reports of folk from the communities of Slaytonthorpe, Raven's Pass, the Isenduin Plantations, and the mining camp of Coalscuttle -- all of those areas have reported people being captured. My information would have ended there, but the glove you supplied, Jelb, that strengthened my spirit-walk and my homing enchantment. The girl was definitely borne just in the past few hours northward into the Blanryde Hills. Kuiper sometimes struggles when we communicate in the dream time, but he was clear on those two things, the proximity to the Blanryde Hills and the timeframe of the past eight or so hours." This message was last edited by the GM at 21:09, Wed 27 May. Message #17 Ch 2 - Supper With Nuanda by 396652 Urvan Hall "That is...remarkable." Urvan exclaimed softly as he glanced about at his companions. "With this information we could have a chance of being on their trail within just a few days." his mood seemed to have lightened somehwat by the revelation, for although the girls fate was tragic, they suspected at least she was alive and that they might have some chance of freeing her from her captors soon. "Are either of you familiar with that region?" he looked between Jelb and Kelpie. Message #18 Ch 2 - Supper With Nuanda by 396648 Kelpie Lawfuller The morning light brought Kelpie awake and he cheerily dug into the first serving of breakfast. He joined Nuanda in her prayer to Demetra, mumbling the familiar words as he worked the biscuits with his gums. When the good witch spoke of her quest, he nodded without hesitation, happy to lend his strength where it was needed. A man of the roads knew many names but not always their exact places "are the Blanryde Hills at the foot o the Coal Hills? he asked between bites seems we've some travel ahead of us. Once he'd eaten his fill biscuits softened between his gums and a handful of blueberries sucked clean Kelpie rose with a contented sigh. He retrieved his armour and began the slow, familiar process of preparing himself for the days journey, piece by piece settling back into the weight and duty of a hedge knight. Message #19 Ch 2 - Supper With Nuanda by Nuanda Nemere () "I haven't been there myself, but I understand from Kuiper that the Blanryde Hills are in a large area west of the Coal Hills, a grouping of villages and towns in an area called Slaytonthorpe. There is a count, a landed noble, there: a Count Parlfray who exercises lordship over that area and collects taxes to be paid in Threshold. I can give you a letter of introduction to give to the ranger, Kuiper. I think that would secure his help for you." Nuanda serves more biscuits and gravy. "As for my quest ask , I need three components for an enchantment I'm working on: (1) an amethyst of at least 50 golden coins' value, (2) a rare herb called Hwyanthemon (I will draw you a picture of what it looks like), and (3) the hair of a slain orc." Completing this quest yields 800 XP per character. This message was last edited by the GM at 18:35, Thu 28 May. Message #20 Ch 2 - Supper With Nuanda by 396648 Kelpie Lawfuller Kelpie made a careful mental note of the witch's requirements, an amethyst, a sprig of Hwyanthemon, and the hair of a slain orc. None of them would be easily come by, but the difficulty didnt trouble him. He straightened, nodding with quiet resolve. We are grateful for your service he said we'll do all I can to see your quest fulfilled. He tightened the last strap of his armour and glanced toward the door, eagerness stirring in him like a horse ready to run let us away to the Blanryde Hills, then, to meet this ranger Kuiper. I'll keep faith the girl still lives, and that well see her safely returned to hearth and home armour donned and purpose renewed, Kelpie stepped toward the door, ready to lead the way onward. Message #21 Ch 2 - Supper With Nuanda by 396652 Urvan Hall "Agreed" Urvan stood and took up his pack, seeming to share Kelpie's urgency to make good upon the incredibly valuable information they had just received. "If we can manage her rescue, it will be a small miracle." he said to himself as much as the others as he took the time to cinch down the strap of his shield to keep it from bouncing. "I do not envy you your armor on this march sir, but I may when welcome to the fight in earnest." he told Kelpie with a faint smile at the corner of his mouth. Message #22 Ch 2 - Supper With Nuanda by 396686 Dungeon Master (GM) nuanda.webpAfter breakfast, Nuanda sends you on your way with four dozen hard biscuits in a bag, and a half gallon of honey in a corked jug. "I recommend joining a caravan traveling from Kirkilston to Raven's Pass. It's five furlongs' distance, a full day of travel, an overnight, and a second full day of travel with caravan wagons. But you're a whole lot more likely to make it to Raven's Pass alive if you travel in greater numbers. There, seek out Nimba at the The Mason's Apron tavern. Tell her that I sent you." This message was last edited by the GM at 20:04, Yesterday. Message #23 Ch 2 - Supper With Nuanda by 396653 Jelb Garrick "We will, of course, be looking out for what you need." Jelb said to Nuanda as he finished off the last bit of his breakfast. He began moving to help Kelpie with his armor. Meanwhile, to the group he said, "We could take that job as caravan guards and head out with it. Safety in numbers would help not just us, but also the other members of that caravan. I believe they were looking to head out as soon as their complement of guards had been filled." He thought for a moment then turned back to Nuanda, "Thank you so much for your guidance and aid. Is there anything else we should know before we set off?" Message #24 Ch 2 - Supper With Nuanda by Nuanda () nuanda.webp"The roads are risky. Bandits. But they're safer than the wilderness. Travel by roads when you can, and if you must go overland, try to hire a guide or get the aid of a ranger or druid. When you reach Raven's Pass and The Mason's Apron , ask Nimba to introduce you to her husband, Samuel. He's the blacksmith. He can tend your armor and weapons if they need attention before you continue on your journey. I thank you for your company. I do not often receive guests. Is there anything else I can do to aid you before you leave?" Message #25 Ch 2 - Supper With Nuanda by 396648 Kelpie Lawfuller A seasoned traveller and knight, Kelpie rested a friendly hand on Urvan's shoulder - sore shoulders and a few blisters ain't nothin to fret over, so long as you're alive he said with the easy confidence of experience - get the best armour ye can, and get used to wearin' it. With his purse empty, Kelpie was glad to hear the others agree to join the caravan. Safety in numbers and coin besides was a welcome prospect the caravan to Ravens Keep is due to leave Kirkliston today he added, hoping to spur them into motion. He turned to Nuanda and dipped his head in gratitude thank ye for your hospitality. Youve been most generous, and Ill not ask for more. Farewell until we meet again armour settled and purpose renewed, Kelpie looked to the road, eager to be on their way. Message #26 Ch 2 - Supper With Nuanda by 396686 Dungeon Master (GM) Please continue on the in-character Chapter 3 thread.

pages.title: Chapter 3 - Joining the Caravan to Raven's Pass
pages.content: =========================================================== Message #1 Ch 3 - Joining the Caravan to Raven's Pass by 396686 Dungeon Master (GM) Sat, 30 May 2026 20:36:12 GMT ----------------------------------------------------------- By the time the sun has been up a full hour, our three stalwarts -- Jelb, Kelpie, and Urvan -- are standing near the center of the hamlet of Kirkilston, along with half a dozen other worthies who are hoping to sign onto the caravan that departs mid-morning for Raven's Pass. This message was last edited by the GM at 15:38, Sat 30 May. =========================================================== Message #2 Ch 3 - Joining the Caravan to Raven's Pass by 396686 Dungeon Master (GM) Sun, 31 May 2026 01:16:32 GMT ----------------------------------------------------------- At two hours past sunrise, dust filters out of the forest impinging on the eastern edge of the hamlet, and the farmers beneath their awnings in the square look alert, sensing the imminent arrival of the caravan from Eastdale - which means customers! A boy employed by Morgan's Morsels has taken food orders from two of the half dozen individuals standing around. Presumably they are potential guards interested in hiring on for the next leg of the journey -- Kirkilston to Raven's Pass. The wagons emerge from the woods to the east, six of them in a queue, each pulled by a pair of mules. Driving the lead wagon is Billworth Turgen of Helix. Men walk alongside the second, fourth, and sixth wagons -- guards no doubt. As the caravan enters the hamlet square, the wagons circle up, not for protection but out of habit. Immediately, Billworth signals for the boy from Morgan's Morsels and begins giving him instructions. The vegetable farmers smile in greeting as soon of those accompanying the caravans approach their kiosks. An attractive brunette emerges from a nearby house and runs to one of the caravan men, who sweeps her up into his arms, swings her around, then kisses her. =========================================================== Message #3 Ch 3 - Joining the Caravan to Raven's Pass by 396653 Jelb Garrick Sun, 31 May 2026 03:40:49 GMT ----------------------------------------------------------- Jelb spent his time waiting in conversation and meditation - pursuing the first when possible, but the second in any free moments. Arcane study was a rigorous demand of one wanted to learn and grow stronger. For the sake of Jelenneth, and to a lesser extent to save his own face from his words the prior night, he deeply desired greater mastery. However much he favored his studies, among men there was a still more powerful tool: conversation. Three men against unnumbered bandits were not odds he favored. Let alone should any of those in the party be denied as guards for any reason. So he struck up conversation with other potential guards: introducing himself as Jelb, laying out the quest upon which he and his companions had staked their honor, and along whether any were willing to join them for reasonable compensating... or at least to not compete against them for caravan spots. OOC: Full share of what we find on bandits and any bounties on them for PCs, book rates for npc assistants to be discussed in ooc thread. =========================================================== Message #4 Ch 3 - Joining the Caravan to Raven's Pass by 396648 Kelpie Lawfuller Fighter 2, AC 2, HP 8/8 Sun, 31 May 2026 06:30:14 GMT ----------------------------------------------------------- After the long march back to Kirkliston, it was a relief to rest a moment while they waited for the caravan. Kelpie made straight for the well, filling his waterskin before splashing cool water over his face and bald head. Refreshed, he settled himself on a nearby bench, helmet off, watching the road for signs of the caravan’s approach. When the wagons finally rolled into view, Kelpie rose to his feet and gave the caravan master a broad wave. He stepped forward with the easy confidence of a man long used to seeking honest work on the road “ho there, friend” he called “need ye caravan guards? We three” he gestured to Jelb and Urvan “seek work as far as Raven’s Keep” his stance was open, his tone respectful, but there was no mistaking the readiness in his eyes. He was prepared to earn his keep. =========================================================== Message #5 Ch 3 - Joining the Caravan to Raven's Pass by 396958 Maximilian Yragerne mystic theurge, of Arcantryl Sun, 31 May 2026 08:49:05 GMT ----------------------------------------------------------- As Kelpie spoke to the caravan master, a fairly tall man walked up as well, wearing a blue and red robe over leather armor, he adds, "Make that four caravan master, I offer my services as well. I may not be as stout a warrior as he, but I'll earn my keep." the stranger says, the holy symbol of Arcantryl hanging from his neck. []( =========================================================== Message #6 Ch 3 - Joining the Caravan to Raven's Pass by 396979 Billworth Turgen (merchant) caravan, master Sun, 31 May 2026 14:11:55 GMT ----------------------------------------------------------- The older gentleman seated on the first wagon rises to his feet and nods appreciation to a stable boy who brings buckets of water for the mules to drink from. "Greetings! I am Billworth Turgen. Perhaps you've visited my establishment in Helix, Turgen's Trade Goods ? This caravan is hauling several thousand gold coins worth of fabric, spices, lumber, iron ingots, and papyrus. The guards who entered the village with me are due a break. They've been with us since we left Helix a week ago. We encountered orcs between Ironguard Motte and Phandalin, but luckily no other hostilities from there until now. In recent weeks, brigands, orcs, and weather have been our banes. In fact, last week we were attacked twice by orcs between here and Raven's Pass, so I'm looking for 7 or 8 guards to hire on." This message was last edited by the player at 09:17, Sun 31 May. =========================================================== Message #7 Ch 3 - Joining the Caravan to Raven's Pass by 396958 Maximilian Yragerne mystic theurge, of Arcantryl Sun, 31 May 2026 15:08:44 GMT ----------------------------------------------------------- "My name is Maximilian Yragerne, (Ear-a-gurn) a servant of Arcantyl. I have a little ability with a blade and can cast a spell or two as well." He replies. "What does the job pay master Turgen, I need work." =========================================================== Message #8 Ch 3 - Joining the Caravan to Raven's Pass by 396979 Billworth Turgen (merchant) caravan, master Sun, 31 May 2026 16:29:49 GMT ----------------------------------------------------------- []( pay is five gold per day, with an additional three if we face combat or disaster. I’ll take you, and you,” he says, pointing to Kelpie and Maximilian. ”And you’re a wise-looking fellow,” he adds, looking at Jelb. ”If you’re willing; and, if so, do you recommend any of these others?” This message was last edited by the player at 13:24, Sun 31 May. =========================================================== Message #9 Ch 3 - Joining the Caravan to Raven's Pass by 396648 Kelpie Lawfuller Fighter 2, AC 2, HP 8/8 Sun, 31 May 2026 19:42:48 GMT ----------------------------------------------------------- In need of coin, Kelpie accepted Billworth’s offer without a hint of bargaining “at your service” he said simply, then gestured toward Urvan “our companion Urvan, a follower of the Crimson Cross. He’ll guard your caravan devoutly.” He turned next to Maximilian, offering a broad, toothless grin “good to meet you, Maximilian. Name’s Kelpie” glancing to the roadside, he nodded toward a patch of shade “we could rest a moment while the caravan master sees to his business. And if ye know magic, perhaps ye can aid us in the matter of a missing girl” his tone was hopeful rather than demanding, an honest man asking honest help. =========================================================== Message #10 Ch 3 - Joining the Caravan to Raven's Pass by 396652 Urvan Hall Sun, 31 May 2026 20:49:44 GMT ----------------------------------------------------------- Urvan moved a little stiffly from their purposeful march across the countryside, and now mingled with their employer and new travelling companions as the caravan prepared to depart. The news that the road had proven so hazardous brought a concerned expression to the young mans countenance, as if he was already girding himself for the likelihood of being set upon, and it seemed to contribute to his already pensive mood. He did not haggle at the price, and merely accepted Kelpie's bargaining on their behalf in stride. Indeed, when Kelpie vouched for him Urvan nodded deeply. "I am at your service sir, of course." he affirmed as he shifted a little beneath his chain hauberk. When Maximilian joined them, his introduction seemed to result in mild surprise. "Truly? You are schooled in the arcane?" he asked before he glanced to Jelb. "You should have much to discuss with Mr. Garrick here, he too has had the benefit of that particular education." =========================================================== Message #11 Ch 3 - Joining the Caravan to Raven's Pass by 396958 Maximilian Yragerne mystic theurge, of Arcantryl Sun, 31 May 2026 21:03:00 GMT ----------------------------------------------------------- Max will shake hands if offered with his new companions, and nods to Urvan when he lets him know that Jelb is also a caster. =========================================================== Message #12 Ch 3 - Joining the Caravan to Raven's Pass by 396986 Thurgan Newl (Ranger and) nephew, of Billworth T Sun, 31 May 2026 21:16:30 GMT ----------------------------------------------------------- A man in his late twenties, possibly early thirties, comes over after rubbing down the pair of mules that are attached to the third wagon. He has overheard Billworth Turgen's words and seen the exchange of greetings between Maximilian and Urvan. He extends his hand to handshake. "Well met, I am Thurgan Newl, Billworth's nephew." The man has a longbow and quiver of arrows, and carries a hunting knife and hatchet on his belt. He regards, Urvan carefully. "It's an honor, sir. My friend Algorn is a Scyntarn, and he says the paladins of St. Ygg are worth three fighting men, two even when injured." My first colored-pencil drawing for this campaign... []( This message was last edited by the player at 16:23, Sun 31 May. =========================================================== Message #13 Ch 3 - Joining the Caravan to Raven's Pass by 396648 Kelpie Lawfuller Fighter 2, AC 2, HP 8/8 Mon, 01 Jun 2026 06:20:37 GMT ----------------------------------------------------------- “Good to meet you, Thurgan. I’m Kelpie” the old fighter gave the well travelled ranger an appraising look, noting the dust of many miles on his cloak and boots “what news o’ the roads?” he asked, leaning in with genuine interest. Years on the highways had taught him that a ranger’s word was worth more than any map. Perhaps some scrap of news, bandits, beasts, strange sightings, might aid them in their search for Jelenneth, or point them toward one of the things Nuanda required. Kelpie’s expression was open and hopeful. =========================================================== Message #14 Ch 3 - Joining the Caravan to Raven's Pass by 396945 Narinza Izrut Drow Thief, "Apprentice" Mon, 01 Jun 2026 06:49:13 GMT ----------------------------------------------------------- A short figure dressed in gray-brown leathers and a muted red cloak approaches the caravan, particularly anyone who looks to be in charge of it. "I would also like to offer my services..." The shortbow and quiver across her back and staff in her hand inform some degree of a readiness to fight. Her hood is worn up, and at a glance a garment resembling either a gaiter or possibly a mask covers much of her face. "I am Narinza." =========================================================== Message #15 Ch 3 - Joining the Caravan to Raven's Pass by 396986 Thurgan Newl (Ranger and) nephew, of Billworth T Mon, 01 Jun 2026 12:45:12 GMT ----------------------------------------------------------- Thurgan notes the dark-skin of the elven woman as he reaches to shake her hand. "Well met, Narinza. You are from the Deep Down? I am Thurgan, a ranger of the Middenmark and the Duchy of Aerik. This is Kelpie Lawfuller, and these two are Jelb Garrick and Urvan Hall. This tall fellow here is Maximilian Yragerne, and like Jelb he is a practioner of the arcane." He sizes Narinza up, noting the bow and staff. "Tell me of yourself, your skills." =========================================================== Message #16 Ch 3 - Joining the Caravan to Raven's Pass by 396949 Geoffroy Morin human, cleric Mon, 01 Jun 2026 15:47:15 GMT ----------------------------------------------------------- Geoffroy goes up to the caravan master, Billworth. "I cans guard, I cans guard real good like. Me hired, right?" He looks at the man expectantly. =========================================================== Message #17 Ch 3 - Joining the Caravan to Raven's Pass by 396979 Billworth Turgen (merchant) caravan, master Mon, 01 Jun 2026 16:16:01 GMT ----------------------------------------------------------- Billworth the caravan master scrutinizes Geoffroy, noting the man's greasy hair and unkempt beard. "Can you fight, or cast spells, or both?" he asks, getting straight to the point. While Geoffroy is formulating a response, Billworth marks his nephew1 Thurgan shaking hands with a petite female2 wearing a red hood. Cutting his eyes toward Morgan's Morsels , he sees a gnome3 exiting with a good-sized hunk of bread. Interesting, on both counts... He sees a boy in his late teens and a village drunk standing near the lead wagon, waiting to speak to him. They don't know it yet (well, maybe the drunk does), but there's no way he will hire either of them. Both are ne'er-do-wells in his book. Does anyone else want a custom portrait for their character? Link back to this game Link back to this game Link back to this game This message was last edited by the player at 14:19, Mon 01 June. =========================================================== Message #18 Ch 3 - Joining the Caravan to Raven's Pass by 396949 Geoffroy Morin human, cleric Mon, 01 Jun 2026 16:45:37 GMT ----------------------------------------------------------- Geoffroy smiles. "I fights. Busts heads." He says, tapping the club hanging from his belt then making smashing motions with his hand. "Whack! Whack! Dead." =========================================================== Message #19 Ch 3 - Joining the Caravan to Raven's Pass by 396686 Dungeon Master (GM) Tue, 02 Jun 2026 01:20:21 GMT ----------------------------------------------------------- Within the hour, Billworth has made his selections, with some input from his nephew Thurgan, and one other fellow, a youth slender and tall, with blond hair whom you've not yet met. Those chosen as guards (assuming they agree to 5 gold daily, and this is -- barring mishap or delay -- a two-day gig) are: Kelpie Urvan Jelb Maximilian Narinza Livy (a gnome) Thurgan Berric Geoffroy So, hex-crawling is dangerous . Really, really dangerous. So dangerous, in fact, that only the very foolish (adventurers), greedy (merchants), or the foolhardy/desperate/overconfident (bandits, orcs and other humanoids, or once again adventurers) are willing to risk it. Traveling well-used roads is safer, generally, because local militias tend to sweep those portions of roads close to settlements and -- less frequently, but far more effectively -- patrols of Red Bannermen and clerics of St. Ygg make sweeps at irregular intervals. This hasn't stopped brigand and humanoid attacks, but it has curbed them in the past decade. Departing from roads (i.e., taking a game trail through the woods, heading overland) is very dangerous. The Northern Reaches have grown over the past four centuries, but outside of cities such as Threshold and Sizemordicus, it remains a frontier. The part of the Northern Reaches that you are currently in is called the Middenmark. Below I show a snapshot of the Northern Reaches. The shaded area containing Rosen and Slaytonthorpe is a subregion known as the Principality of Brine. The shaded area containing Barrowmaze and Ironguard Motte is the Duchy of Aerik. Finally, the shaded area containing Kirkilston is the Middenmark, your current location. []( Each hex in the screenshot above represents 5 miles from one face of a hex to the opposite face. If you were moving on foot, you could cover three hexes' distance in a full day of traveling. But escorting multiple caravan wagons, two hexes if you're lucky, the weather holds, and you aren't attacked. I will be rolling for encounters during the journey. Encounters with wild creatures, monsters, or antagonistic humanoids can resolve into XP either through combat or through negotiation, outsmarting, or out-maneuvering. Gold recovered through travel, heists, or dungeoning can be spent to acquire XP toward leveling. Non-AI aided human-drawn mapping, world-building through roleplayed conversations, journaling in-character in a travel journal, building PC-to-PC and PC-to-NPC relationships: these sorts of things will garner XP. You are on your way, exiting Kirkilston and heading northwest on the road connecting Kirkilston and Raven's Pass. This message was last edited by the GM at 20:25, Mon 01 June. =========================================================== Message #20 Ch 3 - Joining the Caravan to Raven's Pass by 396652 Urvan Hall Tue, 02 Jun 2026 04:30:22 GMT ----------------------------------------------------------- It quickly becomes apparent, even to the ones recently introduced to Urvan, that the young man is no seasoned traveller. As they moved northward he seemed to keep up easily enough despite his chain hauberk, pack, shield and the mace at his belt, but there was something in his demeanor that spoke of straight lines and well swept halls as opposed to wilder places. Indeed, he seemed especially fastidious when it came to his grooming and the state of his clothing, sometimes carefully peering over his white tabard with the red cross insignia for signs of imperfection during their roadside breaks. It was not uncommon at times to see him attack a bit of road dust or pollen with a small brush a cloth, which were part of a kit he carried in a pouch on his belt. It was difficult to say at a glance if this habit was mere vanity, the product of a particularly regimented lifestyle, or something else entirely but it seemed almost second nature to him. “You know these lands well sir?” He asked Thurgan as he came to walk alongside him during the journey. “You were raised in the region perhaps?” he asked as cast a covert glance towards Narinza, as if not quite sure what to make of her. =========================================================== Message #21 Ch 3 - Joining the Caravan to Raven's Pass by 396648 Kelpie Lawfuller Fighter 2, AC 2, HP 8/8 Tue, 02 Jun 2026 06:27:02 GMT ----------------------------------------------------------- The more the merrier. Kelpie greeted the newest recruits to the caravan guard, Narinza and Geoffroy with a welcoming nod “good to have ye both with us” he said, his tone friendly but carrying the weight of experience “if ye’re seekin’ work after we reach Raven’s Pass, we’re on a quest of our own.” He glanced toward the trees to the north, the dark blot on the horizon that marked the edge of the forest hinting at the dangers ahead “the road into the woods, and the hills beyond, will be perilous… but the life of a young girl hangs in the balance.” His toothless smile softened the grim truth, but his eyes showed the resolve of a man who meant to see the task through. =========================================================== Message #22 Ch 3 - Joining the Caravan to Raven's Pass by 396949 Geoffroy Morin human, cleric Tue, 02 Jun 2026 11:29:34 GMT ----------------------------------------------------------- Geoffroy scratches his head. "Huh? Why hang young girlie on balance?" His vicious looking dog raises it's head as he speaks, drool hanging down from it's muzzle. =========================================================== Message #23 Ch 3 - Joining the Caravan to Raven's Pass by 396945 Narinza Izrut Drow Thief, "Apprentice" Tue, 02 Jun 2026 11:46:25 GMT ----------------------------------------------------------- Narinza nods and pulls back her hood, smiling at the strangers. To Thurgan, she replies with a brief stutter, eyes widening, "Ah... In addition to my skill with my staff and my bow, I am light on my feet, perceptive even among my own..." She shuffles ever-so-slightly, just enough to make a slim, semi-flat pouch at her hip jingle. "...and, skilled with tools." As if to save herself from more or less outing herself as a Thief, she adds, "I trained under a trap-maker, you see." She frowns at Kelpie's words and grips her staff, seemingly deep in thought. Her tone becomes more serious, more sincere. "Consider me doubly interested in this work, then. As I am a stranger to you and yours, is there anything that you wish to tell me about this young girl, or perhaps her captors? It matters not in the end, though, as I intend to help you regardless." Her voice is deep and slightly nasal, speech bearing an indescribable accent. =========================================================== Message #24 Ch 3 - Joining the Caravan to Raven's Pass by 396958 Maximilian Yragerne mystic theurge, of Arcantryl Tue, 02 Jun 2026 12:18:50 GMT ----------------------------------------------------------- "He is saying he believes her life is in danger Geoffroy, so we can't waste time if we wish to save her life." Max replies to the apparently slow man. "Is your four legged friend there friendly, or does he bite people he has just met?" He adds as he points to the dog so he'd know what he was talking about. =========================================================== Message #25 Ch 3 - Joining the Caravan to Raven's Pass by 396949 Geoffroy Morin human, cleric Tue, 02 Jun 2026 14:00:21 GMT ----------------------------------------------------------- "Fluffy?" Geoffroy responds when asked about the dog, then he looks at the dog and shrugs. "He ok so long as you not move to quick, or look like you tastes good, or gets between him an some body he want to bite. You know, he did give me uncle Lefty Bill his nickname. Maybes you no try to pets him, ok? =========================================================== Message #26 Ch 3 - Joining the Caravan to Raven's Pass by 396958 Maximilian Yragerne mystic theurge, of Arcantryl Tue, 02 Jun 2026 14:04:38 GMT ----------------------------------------------------------- "Ahh! I thought so, thank you for telling us. If Fluffy wants any of us to pet him, he'll come to us, otherwise, stay away from him." He smiles to the man. =========================================================== Message #27 Ch 3 - Joining the Caravan to Raven's Pass by 396949 Geoffroy Morin human, cleric Tue, 02 Jun 2026 16:40:32 GMT ----------------------------------------------------------- "Oh, an maybe not show teeth. An me know girl life be in danger, she be hanging in Balance, dat got to be danger like. So, do dis caravan go to Balance? Is dat up north? Will she be hanged already when we gets there?" =========================================================== Message #28 Ch 3 - Joining the Caravan to Raven's Pass by 396958 Maximilian Yragerne mystic theurge, of Arcantryl Tue, 02 Jun 2026 17:07:44 GMT ----------------------------------------------------------- Max shrugged his shoulders and pointed to Kelpie, "He's the man in charge of that I guess, maybe he'll know." Max passed the buck to the bald man, not sure how to answer the slow minded man on that one. =========================================================== Message #29 Ch 3 - Joining the Caravan to Raven's Pass by 396949 Geoffroy Morin human, cleric Tue, 02 Jun 2026 18:10:53 GMT ----------------------------------------------------------- "Maybes find girl who in danger closer, not have to go so far..." Geoffroy muses. "Not go all way to Balanced, find girl who be unBalanced first " =========================================================== Message #30 Ch 3 - Joining the Caravan to Raven's Pass by 396986 Thurgan Newl (Ranger and) nephew, of Billworth T Tue, 02 Jun 2026 20:37:51 GMT ----------------------------------------------------------- Thurgan acknowledge's Urvan's questions. "Yes, I was born in Kirkilston May 12, PR 372. I was raised most of my childhood in Eastdale after Kirkilston suffered several orc attacks in 375. My father was killed in that attack. Luckily, my mother was visiting family in Threshold at the time of the attack, and survived. My mother remarried, to my uncle, Billworth Turgen, the caravan master. I've been working for him the last few years. It's a good fit. I'm an outdoors kind of man. I need sunshine, wind, and distant horizons." =========================================================== Message #31 Ch 3 - Joining the Caravan to Raven's Pass by 396653 Jelb Garrick Tue, 02 Jun 2026 21:06:12 GMT ----------------------------------------------------------- Jelb introduced himself as a caster of spells to those running the caravan, and introduced himself as a lifetime resident of Kirkilston to the others. Some who grew up in the town may have actually needed the introduction to him anyways, due to the amount of time he had spent in his studies ever since he was a younger teen and his gift manifested. He had still kept tabs on the town through his brother, and through occasional visits to the inn as he had done quite recently and ended up on this quest. Jelb was greatly cheered by the number of people who seemed willing to put themselves in harms way for Jelenneth. He had been willing to do his best, but with what seemed to be a vast network of banditry arrayed against them, he had not actually been that optimistic about their chances. "Have any of you had much experience dealing with bandits?" He asked. pages.title: Chapter 5 - A Betentacled Escape
pages.content: =========================================================== Message #1 Ch 5 - A Betentacled Escape by 396986 Thurgan Newl (Billworth's nephew) Billworth's, nephew Mon, 29 Jun 2026 20:42:29 GMT ----------------------------------------------------------- A half hour later Thurgan reappears in the small tree-enclosed glade near the road - where the party is resting after their harrowing battle and narrow escape. "We gave as good as we got; maybe better," is the ranger's assessment. "I have no idea what the tentacled horror was, but there is no sign of it. I'm guessing it went back into the pit." He glances toward where the wagons are circled in the glade. "Billworth is injured but will recover; we lost four guards and will pay their families weregild." He sighs and looks at his boots. "I couldn't determine what happened to the paladin or the drow..." This message was last updated by the player at 16:35, Mon 29 June. =========================================================== Message #2 Ch 5 - A Betentacled Escape by 396949 Geoffroy Morin Human, Fighter 1 6 hp Mon, 29 Jun 2026 23:37:26 GMT ----------------------------------------------------------- "Dat's a lots o cal-o-mari back at da pit. Maybes we takes a tent-it-cool to da market?" Geoffroy suggests. =========================================================== Message #3 Ch 5 - A Betentacled Escape by 396648 Kelpie Lawfuller Fighter 3, AC 2, HP 12/12 Tue, 30 Jun 2026 06:33:00 GMT ----------------------------------------------------------- As they finally rested, Kelpie found his thoughts circling the horrors they had escaped. He wasn’t sure which was worse, the orcspawn that had hounded them through the woods, or the monstrous thing that dwelt in the depths of the mine. Either one could have ended them. Together, they had nearly done so. The hedge knight stripped off his helm and sat down heavily, feeling every bruise and ache earned that day. None of them had been prepared for a battle like this “a difficult road yer uncle has chosen” he remarked to Thurgan, rubbing a hand across his brow “is it safe for us to rest the night here?” the question carried no fear, only the practical concern of a man who had survived too many ambushes to take quiet moments for granted. To Geoffroy, he shook his head “there’s much smaller and safer prey we can hunt in the forest, praise be to Herne. Let us leave the mother o’ monsters in the pit where she belongs” Kelpie leaned back against the wagon wheel, sword across his knees, eyes still scanning the treeline even as exhaustion pulled at him. Rest was needed but vigilance would keep them alive. =========================================================== Message #4 Ch 5 - A Betentacled Escape by 396958 Maximilian Yragerne mystic theurge, of Arcantryl Tue, 30 Jun 2026 08:55:29 GMT ----------------------------------------------------------- Max just sat quietly with the others, back against a wagon wheel, taking a sip of water and a nibble on rations, as he sat and contemplated the day's events. =========================================================== Message #5 Ch 5 - A Betentacled Escape by 396653 Jelb Garrick Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:33:07 GMT ----------------------------------------------------------- Jelb had briefly considered asking Thurgen for a new set of clothing so that he wouldn't have to wear robes. That way, he could let the most immediate danger fall on someone else. By the time they reached the resting place, he had long since crushed that thought. "They have probably been taken." Jelb said flatly in response to Thurgen. He went on to explain what had been on the scroll carried by one of the Orcs they'd slain near the creek. "I hope explains what had been going on in the area as well, and that elusive orcs are what has caused the rumors of bandits. Nothing in the scroll tells them to prepare to work with anyone else, so I'd expect the orcs would be attacking bandits if they saw them." This message was last edited by the GM at 07:16, Tue 30 June. =========================================================== Message #6 Ch 5 - A Betentacled Escape by 396986 Thurgan Newl (Billworth's nephew) Billworth's, nephew Tue, 30 Jun 2026 18:44:16 GMT ----------------------------------------------------------- Thurgan takes his time looking at the scroll that Jelb recovered from one of the slain orcs. "Toothbreakers. I know of them. They are a very large orcish clan that dwell in the hills above Milborne, a few days' travel northwest of here. But ... 'Deep Friends'; I don't have any idea who that refers to. It mentions a Red Tusk of the Deep Friends. That sounds like somebody in a position of power. This is disconcerting. Orcspawn are evil to the core and vicious through and through, but they aren't known for their long reach. This scroll reads like something you'd more expect of a thieves' guild. And look here, the Raven's Pass trail is mentioned specifically. These orcs were lazy and didn't maintain a careful lookout. If they had, they'd have been able to ambush us. We probably would have fallen." The ranger hands the scroll back to Jelb, then turns to where Geoffroy, Kelpie, and Maximilian are in conversation. "What should we do about Urvan? I don't mean to be political, but the drow woman's absence won't cause a stir like the loss of one of the Red Bannermen. This could bring unwanted scrutiny upon all of us from the Prelacy." =========================================================== Message #7 Ch 5 - A Betentacled Escape by 396958 Maximilian Yragerne mystic theurge, of Arcantryl Tue, 30 Jun 2026 20:09:46 GMT ----------------------------------------------------------- "No one saw him fall, did he leave, or was he killed or taken by the orcs as a trophy for this 'Red Tusk' perhaps? As far as that goes, this Narinza was a drow, could she have been colluding with the orcs to take him?" Max posited to no one in particular. =========================================================== Message #8 Ch 5 - A Betentacled Escape by 396686 Dungeon Master (GM) Tue, 30 Jun 2026 21:45:52 GMT ----------------------------------------------------------- Thurgan says, "I don't know the truth of it, but some folks think the Drow were behind the Elves leaving, the surface ones. The Glittering Canopy is empty, as is Aelith-Calaer." This message was last edited by the GM at 16:45, Tue 30 June. =========================================================== Message #9 Ch 5 - A Betentacled Escape by 396686 Dungeon Master (GM) Tue, 30 Jun 2026 22:13:02 GMT ----------------------------------------------------------- As you discuss your options, Thurgan glances up at the sound of a birdcall. "That wasn't a thicket finch. That was Fentrest," he says, indicating one of the guards on lookout several yards away. Thurgan knocks an arrow and melts into the nearby trees but isn't gone but a few seconds before a man emerges from the south into the glade. It is Algorn Druff, the witch-hunter you met at the tavern-inn back in Kirkilston. []( sent me, using her magic. She has been scrying your progress and saw the orc attack." Thurgan emerges from the trees, reading the companions' body language and slowly releasing tension on his bowstring as he perceives that several of you know this man. It is now two hours until sunset. =========================================================== Message #10 Ch 5 - A Betentacled Escape by 396653 Jelb Garrick Tue, 30 Jun 2026 23:34:48 GMT ----------------------------------------------------------- Jelb wondered what kind of cost Nuanda must have had to pay to send Algorn, but he welcomed the man sincerely with an extended hand. "Well met, again. We are thankful for the support and your willingness to come out and help us, especially after so deadly an afternoon as we've had!" He shared the information from the scroll with Algorn as well, before asking the group: "I'll go along with the will of the group, but I would think we might want to move another half of an hour or an hour down the road as we talk - getting just a little more distance between us and the third of the orcs that turned back or were disabled without dying might pay off, but it also puts us that much farther from our friends if they remain free."
