pages.title: Break the Red Thicket Ambushes
pages.content: Break the Red Thicket Ambushes Gnolls and orcs use the Red Thicket Pass and the Ford-at-the-River-Isenduin to waylay merchants. Find the force coordinating the ambushes and make the trade route safer without simply moving the danger to another crossing. Quest ID: investigate-red-thicket-ambushes Giver: Merchants and caravan leaders using the Northern Reaches trade route Visibility: party-only PWA status: available Objectives Examine recent ambush sites for a common pattern or command structure. Protect or bait a caravan to identify the attackers’ staging area. Locate the gnoll or orc leader directing the attacks. Break the ambush network or negotiate a safer arrangement for travelers. Reward Caravan payments, recovered cargo, and a reputation with Northern Reaches merchants PWA source:

pages.title: Captives of Shrieken Mire
pages.content: Captives of Shrieken Mire Blue goblins have carried several townsfolk into Shrieken Mire, territory protected by lizardfolk who worship the ancient green dragon Inzeldrin. Quest ID: captives-shrieken-mire Giver: Survivors of Slaytonthorpe Visibility: party-only PWA status: available Objectives Track the captives into the mire. Learn why the goblins took them. Rescue any survivors. Avoid provoking Inzeldrin or turning the lizardfolk against Slaytonthorpe. Reward To be arranged with the rescued families; possible goblin salvage PWA source:

pages.title: Chart the Iron Road to Barakuir
pages.content: Chart the Iron Road to Barakuir Quest ID: chart-barakuir-iron-road Summary: Trace the ancient tunnel connection between Altgrimmr and the duergar stronghold of Barakuir, documenting what remains passable and what dangers now occupy the route. Giver: A historian or tunnel-master of Altgrimmr Objectives Locate the surviving entrance to the old Altgrimmr–Barakuir tunnel route. Map a safe section and identify collapses, sealed gates, or hostile outposts. Recover a surviving marker or record proving how the route was used. Return with a map that can support future dwarven expeditions. Reward Dwarven coin, mapping privileges, and access to an old route through the mountains Prerequisites None recorded in the PWA registry. PWA Source

pages.title: Completed Quests
pages.content: The K-R-K Caravan Run

pages.title: Contain the Soul Fungus at Mordoom Keep
pages.content: Contain the Soul Fungus at Mordoom Keep The Sporebane Brotherhood needs an expedition to the epicenter of Mordoom Keep's Soul Fungus outbreak. Assess whether the infection is spreading, trace Elowen Starshadow's missing mentor, and recover research or samples that may help contain the plague. Quest ID: contain-soul-fungus-mordoom Giver: Elowen Starshadow and Eldreth Moss-Walker Visibility: party-only PWA status: available Objectives Survey Mordoom Keep for new fungal growth and infected wildlife. Trace Elowen's mentor's final expedition into the keep. Recover the mentor's research, remains, or both. Secure a contained sample without looking directly at active fungal growths. Return to the Sporebane Brotherhood before any infection can incubate. Reward Sporebane protective magic, treatment during incubation, and salvage rights PWA source:

pages.title: Defend the Watchtower of Westkeep
pages.content: Defend the Watchtower of Westkeep Help the fortified monastery at Westkeep prepare for threats against its apprentice clerics, guards, and religious studies. Quest ID: defend-westkeep-watchtower Giver: The abbot of the Watchtower Visibility: party-only PWA status: available Objectives Assess the monastery's defenses and the vulnerable wooden staircase. Identify who or what is threatening the Watchtower. Help secure the apprentices and hold the monastery through the danger. Reward Temple support, healing, and a formal favor from the Watchtower PWA source:

pages.title: Escort the Forgehome Ore Train
pages.content: Escort the Forgehome Ore Train Quest ID: escort-forgehome-ore-train Summary: Protect a shipment of smelted ore traveling from Forgehome toward Citadel Silver and learn who is testing the friendly trade route between the two dwarven communities. Giver: Forgehome mine factors or Citadel Silver merchants Objectives Join the ore shipment at Forgehome and establish the route’s weak points. Protect the miners, wagons, and ore through the Shallows. Identify whether attacks are opportunistic, duergar-directed, or politically motivated. Deliver the shipment and report any evidence of a wider threat. Reward Dwarven wages, masterwork goods at a discount, and trust from both communities Prerequisites None recorded in the PWA registry. PWA Source

pages.title: Establish the Darkforest Fort
pages.content: Establish the Darkforest Fort Reglar 'The Ashbow' Lightstep is hiring able-bodied adventurers to help construct a fort in the Darkforest. Escort workers and supplies to the eastern shore of Donally Lake, secure the building site, and defend the expedition until the fort is usable. Quest ID: establish-darkforest-fort Giver: Reglar 'The Ashbow' Lightstep Visibility: individual-or-party PWA status: available Objectives Meet Reglar Lightstep and agree upon wages and responsibilities. Assemble the workers, tools, and supplies needed for construction. Travel approximately twelve miles southwest of Kirkilston to Donally Lake. Survey and secure a defensible site on the lake's eastern shore. Protect the workers until they complete a usable fortification. Reward Wages to be negotiated with Reglar Lightstep PWA source:

pages.title: Explore Malvik's Tower
pages.content: Explore Malvik's Tower Locate the long-lost tower of Malvik the Mad in the forest north of Raven's Pass and investigate the extensive dungeons beneath it. Determine whether Malvik still survives as a lich and recover what can safely be taken from his trove. Quest ID: explore-malviks-tower Giver: Rumors among travelers at Raven's Pass Visibility: party-only PWA status: available Objectives Search east of the trail north of Raven's Pass for Malvik's lost tower. Enter and explore the dungeons beneath the tower. Determine whether Malvik became a lich and still inhabits the complex. Return with proof of the tower's location and any safely recovered lore or treasure. Reward Any gold and magic recovered from Malvik's unclaimed trove PWA source:

pages.title: Expose the Darkeyes’ Sewer Route
pages.content: Expose the Darkeyes’ Sewer Route Quest ID: expose-darkeyes-sewer-route Summary: Help uncover how Retep Garnetstone’s Darkeyes move contraband and people through the sewers beneath Eastdale and the Middenmark while avoiding a war with the city’s spies. Giver: A threatened merchant, rival guild, or lawkeeper Objectives Confirm that Retep’s relic shop is a cover for a wider smuggling network. Trace one discreet passage through the Eastdale or Middenmark sewers. Determine which goods or people are being moved and who benefits. Choose whether to expose the route, exploit it, or use it to protect someone endangered by the Red Laws. Reward Information, black-market access, or a bounty from the party that commissioned the investigation Prerequisites None recorded in the PWA registry. PWA Source

pages.title: Find a Contact in Tien Lung
pages.content: Find a Contact in Tien Lung Establish a trustworthy trade or information contact in Tien Lung, the distant city known for commerce, political intrigue, and indulgence. Quest ID: seek-tien-lung-contact Giver: A Northern Reaches trader with distant interests Visibility: individual-or-party PWA status: available Objectives Learn which Tien Lung merchant, envoy, or household can be trusted. Carry a sealed introduction or trade proposal to the city. Return with a reliable contact and the terms of future dealings. Reward A commission on future trade and payment for a successful introduction PWA source:

pages.title: Find a Route into the Shallows
pages.content: Find a Route into the Shallows Locate a usable entrance to the Shallows, the upper portion of the Underdark, and document the first stretch well enough for a cautious expedition. Quest ID: find-shallows-surface-route Giver: A scholar of the Underdark Visibility: party-only PWA status: available Objectives Identify a surface entrance leading into the Shallows. Survey the first safe landmarks and hazards below ground. Return with a route description and evidence that the passage reaches the Upperdark. Reward A research fee, mapping supplies, and an expeditionary share of recovered treasure Prerequisites Unlocked by: find-doors-of-galduhr PWA source:

pages.title: Find Jelenneth or Learn Her Fate
pages.content: Search for Jelenneth, missing daughter of Parker and Heldrith Laneworth, share-croppers on five acres northwest of Kirkilston. She has been missing since April 27, 406 PR. Quest to rescue her or (perish the thought) learn her fate in order to give her family closure. This quest is Active ; it was accepted by the PCs on May 06, 406 PR.

pages.title: Find the Cold Mouth
pages.content: Find the Cold Mouth Follow the route recorded in the recovered Tooth-Breaker orders to locate the Cold Mouth, where Red-Tusk's orcs deliver kidnapped scholars, priests, craftspeople, and laborers to mysterious Deep Friends. Rescue any surviving captives and uncover who or what is collecting them. Quest ID: find-the-cold-mouth Giver: The recovered Tooth-Breaker orders Visibility: party-only PWA status: available Objectives Decode the crude route beginning near Slaytonthorpe. Follow the dead stream and broken stones beyond the thorn hills. Locate the watcher-mark and the entrance called the Cold Mouth. Rescue captives awaiting collection by the Deep Friends. Identify the Deep Friends and learn why they seek maps, sealed doors, old tunnels, and knowledge of the deep places. Reward Any supplies or treasure seized from the kidnappers, plus gratitude from rescued captives PWA source:

pages.title: Find the Doors of Galduhr
pages.content: Find the Doors of Galduhr Continue Bran Hammerspike's decades-long search for the fabled Doors of Galduhr, the lost entrance to the dwarven kingdom of Gundgathol. Retrace the expedition he undertook with Crynwyth Ironfist in the Moon Peaks, survive the elemental dangers they encountered, and find evidence that reveals the Doors' location. Quest ID: find-doors-of-galduhr Giver: A dwarven historian seeking Gundgathol Visibility: party-only PWA status: available Objectives Research Bran Hammerspike's expeditions in search of the Doors of Galduhr. Retrace Bran and Crynwyth Ironfist's route through the Moon Peaks. Find evidence of their encounter with a fire elemental. Recover maps, markers, or records left during Bran's search. Locate the Doors of Galduhr or establish the strongest surviving lead to them. Reward Dwarven treasure or historical artifacts recovered during the expedition PWA source:

pages.title: Find the Giant's Grave
pages.content: Find the Giant's Grave Search the heart of the Darkforest for the legendary grave of a giant slain by a red-scaled, horned dragon. Verify the old tale, discover what became of the dragon, and recover any relics buried with the giant. Quest ID: find-darkforest-giants-grave Giver: Rumors among travelers at Raven's Pass Visibility: party-only PWA status: available Objectives Gather accounts describing the giant, the horned dragon, and possible landmarks. Travel into the heart of the Darkforest. Locate and enter the giant's grave. Determine whether the dragon survived or left descendants behind. Recover proof of the grave's discovery and any safely transportable relics. Reward Any unclaimed treasure recovered from the grave PWA source:

pages.title: Find the Missing Fevered
pages.content: Find the Missing Fevered Three of five Raven's Pass townsfolk afflicted by Dream Fever vanished during the previous week instead of being found in the surrounding fields and hills. Investigate Harl's suspicion that the disappearances are connected to Xanderpetals, recover any survivors, and discover what is taking the Fevered. Quest ID: find-missing-fevered Giver: Harl of Raven's Pass Visibility: party-only PWA status: available Objectives Question Harl and the families of the three missing townsfolk. Search the fields and hills between the town and Raven's Pass. Determine how Xanderpetals or Dream Fever relate to the disappearances. Recover any survivors and stop whatever is taking the Fevered. Reward 75 gp pooled by the affected families, plus salvage rights PWA source:

pages.title: Find Urvan and Narinza
pages.content: Find Urvan and Narinza Determine what happened to Urvan and Narinza after they were separated from the party during the flight from Blightstone Pit. Quest ID: find-urvan-and-narinza Giver: Shade and the party Visibility: individual-or-party PWA status: active Objectives Follow signs of the missing companions from Blightstone Pit. Find Urvan and Narinza, or learn their fates. Reward Not specified in the PWA quest record. PWA source:

pages.title: Free Slaytonthorpe from the Terror of Red Tusk
pages.content: Fulfill Cromm's command to Neria by discovering the nature of Red Tusk and ending the terror afflicting Slaytonthorpe. Quest ID: free-slaytonthorpe Giver: Cromm, through Neria Silverdale Visibility: individual-or-party PWA status: active Objectives Learn who or what Red Tusk is. Travel to Slaytonthorpe. Free Slaytonthorpe from Red Tusk's terror. Reward Not specified in the PWA quest record. PWA source:

pages.title: Free the Prisoner of Branderscar
pages.content: Free the Prisoner of Branderscar Quest ID: free-the-branderscar-prisoner Summary: Determine why a prisoner in Branderscar claims to possess evidence about a hidden threat in the Fangorran Range, then decide whether the prisoner deserves rescue. Giver: A worried relative or an intermediary in Rosen Objectives Identify the prisoner and learn the charge that placed them in Branderscar. Verify the prisoner’s claim without exposing an innocent accomplice. Reach the mountain prison or arrange a lawful extraction. Decide whether to free the prisoner, expose a greater crime, or leave them confined. Reward A useful contact in Rosen, legal favor, and whatever evidence the prisoner can safely surrender Prerequisites None recorded in the PWA registry. PWA Source

pages.title: Gated Quests
pages.content: Gated Quests Map the Entrance to Kharaz-Ankor Keep the Cult from Valashinaz Reopen the Way to the Gauntwood Galleries Find a Route into the Shallows

pages.title: Gather Secrets for Nimba
pages.content: Gather Secrets for Nimba Help Nimba Armstrong gather intelligence from the miners, guards, and travelers frequenting the Mason's Apron without exposing her life as a deep-cover spy. Identify information that could threaten the Nemere family's interests and report it to Nimba discreetly. Quest ID: gather-secrets-for-nimba Giver: Nimba Armstrong Visibility: individual-or-party PWA status: available Objectives Meet Nimba discreetly at the Mason's Apron. Observe conversations among the tavern's miners, guards, and travelers. Identify secrets or developing events relevant to Nimba's interests. Investigate the most credible lead without exposing Nimba's involvement. Deliver the intelligence privately to Nimba while preserving her cover. Reward Nimba Armstrong's favor and access to selected intelligence from her network PWA source:

pages.title: Guard the Citadel Silver Caravan
pages.content: Guard the Citadel Silver Caravan Protect a dwarven caravan traveling between Citadel Silver and the Northern Reaches along the route where earlier Crumwich caravans suffered a deadly gnoll ambush. Quest ID: guard-citadel-silver-caravan Giver: Regent Baraguld Crumwich Visibility: party-only PWA status: available Objectives Join the caravan and learn its planned route and cargo. Identify signs of flind-led gnoll activity before the ambush point. Deliver the caravan safely to its destination. Reward Dwarven pay, trade goods, and future contracts from Citadel Silver Prerequisites Unlocked by: k-r-k-caravan-run PWA source:

pages.title: Harvest Xanderpetals
pages.content: Harvest Xanderpetals Gosterwick's supply of Xanderpetals is running dangerously low. Travel to the cold, barren lands where the plant grows, gather enough of its vivid red flowers to replenish the town's stores, and return before the remaining sedative tonic is exhausted. Quest ID: harvest-xanderpetals Giver: A healer of Gosterwick Visibility: individual-or-party PWA status: available Objectives Learn how to identify and safely harvest Xanderpetals. Travel to the cold, barren lands where the plant grows. Gather enough intact flowers to replenish Gosterwick's medicinal stores. Return the Xanderpetals to Gosterwick before its remaining tonic is exhausted. Reward To be arranged with Gosterwick's healers PWA source:

pages.title: Help Reglar Ashbow Construct a Fort in the Darkforest
pages.content: Help Reglar Ashbow Construct a Fort in the Darkforest Help Reglar Ashbow construct a fort on the eastern shore of Donally Lake in the Darkforest. Quest ID: construct-darkforest-fort Giver: Reglar Ashbow Visibility: individual-or-party PWA status: available Objectives Meet Reglar Ashbow and agree upon the work. Travel to the eastern shore of Donally Lake. Help construct and secure the fort. Reward Not specified in the PWA quest record. PWA source:

pages.title: Hunt the Trolls of the Darkforest
pages.content: Hunt the Trolls of the Darkforest Travelers claim that trolls roam the Darkforest, threatening villages and charcoal camps that depend on its timber and game. Find out whether the rumor describes one predator or a larger danger and stop the attacks if possible. Quest ID: hunt-darkforest-troll Giver: The Hamlet Watch of Kirkilston or nearby forest villages Visibility: party-only PWA status: available Objectives Collect reliable accounts of recent troll sightings or attacks. Track the troll threat through the forest bogs and rough terrain. Determine how many trolls are active and where they lair. Drive off or destroy the threat and warn the forest settlements. Reward A community payment, salvage from abandoned camps, and local goodwill PWA source:

pages.title: Investigate Doneldun's Den
pages.content: Investigate Doneldun's Den Quest ID: investigate-donelduns-den Summary: Learn why the dragon turtle Doneldun has remained silent since the last verified conversation with Halathra Moonbeam, and determine whether a new danger is disturbing Lake Donally. Giver: A Demetran druid or lakeside community Objectives Find the site where Halathra Moonbeam reportedly held palaver with Doneldun. Determine whether the dragon turtle is still present and why it has withdrawn. Investigate threats affecting Lake Donally or the ruins around Aelith-Calaer. Return with an account that can guide future contact or prevent a lake disaster. Reward A favor from the Demetran faithful, safe passage on Lake Donally, and any recovered lake treasure Prerequisites None recorded in the PWA registry. PWA Source

pages.title: Investigate the Cold Mouth and the Deep Friends
pages.content: Investigate the Cold Mouth and the Deep Friends Investigate the Cold Mouth named in the recovered Toothbreaker orders and identify the Deep Friends collecting captives there. Quest ID: investigate-cold-mouth Giver: Recovered Toothbreaker orders Visibility: party-only PWA status: available Objectives Locate the Cold Mouth north of Slaytonthorpe. Identify Red Tusk and the Deep Friends. Discover what happened to the captives taken there. Reward Not specified in the PWA quest record. PWA source:

pages.title: Investigate the Rot in the Forbidden Zone
pages.content: Investigate the Rot in the Forbidden Zone Enter the Forbidden Zone and investigate reports that the worship of Impurax, the Rotten God, has reappeared there. Identify the resurgent cult's leaders, learn what they are cultivating or corrupting, and prevent the blight from spreading beyond the ruined region. Quest ID: investigate-impurax-resurgence Giver: A Scyntarn witch-hunter Visibility: party-only PWA status: available Objectives Find evidence of Impurax's renewed worship in the Forbidden Zone. Identify any Putrescalate cleric-druids or warriors of the Fanged Legion. Discover the cult's source of pestilence, rot, or corrupted fungal life. Destroy or contain the immediate threat and report what remains. Reward Not specified in the PWA quest record. PWA source:

pages.title: Keep the Cult from Valashinaz
pages.content: Keep the Cult from Valashinaz After the Lost Caverns of Achaia are opened, prevent dragon-cult interests from learning whether Valashinaz still waits beneath ruined Achaia. Quest ID: keep-cult-from-valashinaz Giver: Delk Whitewand Visibility: party-only PWA status: available Objectives Search recovered Achaian maps and tomes for references to Valashinaz. Watch for Cult of the Dragon agents pursuing the same knowledge. Secure or destroy the clues before they draw dangerous attention to Achaia. Reward Not specified in the PWA quest record. Prerequisites Unlocked by: plumb-lost-caverns PWA source:

pages.title: Make Blightstone Pit Safe Again
pages.content: Make Blightstone Pit Safe Again Investigate the creature lairing beneath Blightstone Pit so the old quarry can stop threatening travelers and become useful again. Quest ID: cleanse-blightstone-pit Giver: Algorn Druff Visibility: party-only PWA status: available Objectives Locate the pit and confirm the creature's lair. Learn whether the creature is connected to the orc attacks or only feeding on the chaos. Drive off or destroy the creature and verify the quarry is safe. Reward Possible quarry rights, salvage, or treasure from prior victims PWA source:

pages.title: Map the Edge of the Bauthwaf
pages.content: Map the Edge of the Bauthwaf Chart a route along the edge of the Bauthwaf, the network of tunnels around Menzoberranzan patrolled by elite drow riding driders. Quest ID: map-bauthwaf-border-tunnels Giver: A surface guide seeking a safer Underdark route Visibility: party-only PWA status: available Objectives Find a defensible approach to the Bauthwaf. Map landmarks and crossings without drawing the patrols' attention. Return with a route that distinguishes safe passages from drow-controlled ground. Reward Payment for the map and a share of any safely recovered Underdark salvage PWA source:

pages.title: Map the Entrance to Kharaz-Ankor
pages.content: Map the Entrance to Kharaz-Ankor After the Keep on the Borderlands is retaken, survey the passages beneath it and determine whether they truly lead to Kharaz-Ankor. Quest ID: map-kharaz-ankor-entrance Giver: Nolo Silvershaper Visibility: party-only PWA status: available Objectives Secure the below-ground access after the keep is cleared. Map the first safe route beneath the keep. Bring Nolo Silvershaper proof of whether the passage leads to Kharaz-Ankor. Reward Not specified in the PWA quest record. Prerequisites Unlocked by: reclaim-keep-on-borderlands PWA source:

pages.title: Map the Horgrim Tunnels
pages.content: Map the Horgrim Tunnels Ancient tunnels beneath the Darkforest may connect the surface to the Underdark, the Forbidden Zone, and lands beneath Slaytonthorpe. Chart a safe initial route before someone else uses the forgotten passages for an attack or kidnapping. Quest ID: map-horgrim-tunnel-routes Giver: A ranger, caravan master, or settlement threatened by the tunnels Visibility: party-only PWA status: available Objectives Locate a surviving entrance to the Horgrim Tunnels. Survey the first section and record landmarks, hazards, and branching passages. Determine whether the old underground river is truly dry or has been diverted. Return with a usable map and warning about any active occupants. Reward Payment for the map and ordinary salvage recovered during the survey PWA source:

pages.title: Plumb the Depths of the Lost Caverns
pages.content: A mage staying at the Circle K Inn gives his name as Delk Whitewand. He claims that the Lost Caverns of Achaia have been discovered and that he will provide magical support and financing to those willing to risk life and limb to plumb its long-lost secrets. Delk will pay a group of four to ten individuals ten gold daily for up to six months to delve the Lost Caverns (assuming he is correct in thinking he has found the entrance). He is happy to cede any found treasure to those risking themselves to recover them, with the exception that he be given any scrolls and tomes found. "I can provide a few useful potions to get you started, and I can have a few more ready for you a couple weeks from now..." Delk will pay an initial sum of 100 gold as a good faith token and to provide currency for needed exploration supplies.

pages.title: Protect the Glickstonehome Patrols
pages.content: Protect the Glickstonehome Patrols The Flickerdiggles clan patrols the warrens, fields, and pastures around Glickstonehome against brigands and beasts. Join a patrol, identify the source of a growing threat, and keep the surface village safe long enough for the clan to respond. Quest ID: protect-glickstonehome-patrols Giver: Jelbys Flickerdiggles Visibility: individual-or-party PWA status: available Objectives Learn the patrol routes and recent signs of brigands or dangerous beasts. Escort a patrol through the exposed fields and nearby hills. Track the threat to its camp, lair, or source of supplies. Protect the warrens and report whether the danger is likely to return. Reward Gnome hospitality, a negotiated payment, and future access to Glickstonehome’s patrol network PWA source:

pages.title: Protect the Thicket Wood
pages.content: Protect the Thicket Wood Quest ID: protect-thicket-wood Summary: Find out whether the legendary treants or wood elves of the Red Thicket are reacting to illegal logging, and prevent a conflict from closing the road through Raven’s Pass. Giver: Raven’s Pass woodcutters or a St. Ygg road official Objectives Identify who is cutting in the Thicket Wood and why. Locate signs of treant or wood-elf intervention without provoking it. Negotiate terms that protect the oldest trees while keeping the road supplied. Stop any immediate threat before the forest retaliates against Raven’s Pass. Reward Safe passage through the Red Thicket, timber rights or supplies, and a forest faction’s cautious goodwill Prerequisites None recorded in the PWA registry. PWA Source

pages.title: Quest 3 Items for Nuanda Nemere
pages.content: Nuanda Nemere offers a quest for the retrieval of three items, to be brought to her as soon as possible: an amethyst worth at least 50 gp the hair of a deceased orc Hwyanthemon For completion of this quest, up to four PCs can gain 800 XP each. This quest is good for six months of in-game time (April 7 to Oct 7, 406 PR, beyond which Nuanda will no longer need these items, or will have acquired them through another means.

pages.title: Quest Caravan Kirkilston to Raven's Pass
pages.content: Each Friday, a caravan that has traveled from Citadel Silver to Eastdale, then onward to Kirkilston makes its way to Raven's Pass. The caravan master is a dwarf name Obold Rivenshield. He is a 2nd level Fighter and merchant for King Crumwich of Forge. The dwarves of Forge hold Citadel Silver as a vassal stronghold. Obold can offer a total round-trip (2-day) caravan run from Kirkilston to Raven's Pass and then back to Kirkilston. It pays 30 gold per day, so 60 gp for the round trip. Typically, Obold hires a total of four guards, though for particularly valuable shipments he may hire up to double that number. The primary dangers faced on these merchant runs are wild animals, goblins, and orcs. Completing this quest earns the 'Friends of the Citadel' tag for the PC party.

pages.title: Quest Givers
pages.content: Delk Whitewand Nolo Silvershaper Nuanda Nemere Obold Rivenshield

pages.title: Quests Index
pages.content: Givers of Quests Available Quests Active Quests Completed Quests Withdrawn Quests Gated Quests

pages.title: Reclaim Golbrandur’s Outer Gate
pages.content: Reclaim Golbrandur’s Outer Gate Quest ID: reclaim-golbrandur-outer-gate Summary: Aid Elbramoth Battlebeard in opening a defensible approach to Golbrandur while the dracolich and dragon cultists remain entrenched in the ancient dwarven city-fortress. Giver: Elbramoth Battlebeard Objectives Reach the outer approach to Golbrandur without drawing the full attention of the entrenched cult. Locate a defensible gate, breach, or forgotten service entrance. Disrupt the defenders long enough for Elbramoth’s forces to establish a foothold. Report what the expedition learned about the dracolich’s defenses. Reward Dwarven payment, military favor, and a share of any treasure recovered from the secured approach Prerequisites None recorded in the PWA registry. PWA Source

pages.title: Reclaim the Keep on the Borderlands
pages.content: North of the Blackened Forest and roughly twenty miles west of Rosen, there is in the foothills of the Icepeak Range, a large keep. For decades it was abandoned, but in the past several years has become a stronghold for goblins and their bugbear superiors. Rumor has it that the keep is ruled by a particularly vicious commander. A trio of dwarves from Citadel Silver believe that the Keep on the Borderlands sits atop an entrance to an ancient dwarf-hold -- perhaps Kharaz-Ankor itself! They therefore want the keep re-taken. Towards this end, they are looking to hire mercenaries or adventurers to clear the keep of its current occupants. They're offering to fund a party of up to six individuals at 25 gold daily (for the entire party, not per individual) for up to fourteen days. They'll throw in a bounty of 5 gp per goblin tongue brought back to them. The man dwarf to talk to if you're interested in this quest is Nolo Silvershaper. He can be found 80% of the time at Citadel Silver. The other 20% of the time he's liable to be located at one of the following places: Eastdale, Ironguard Motte, and Threshold.

pages.title: Recover the Achaian Inscriptions
pages.content: Recover the Achaian Inscriptions Muirron the Magician collects Archaians, Archomancy, spellbooks, scrolls, and ancient lore. Bring him a safe, legible inscription from a ruin or dungeon without allowing its magic or custodians to follow the party home. Quest ID: recover-achaian-inscriptions Giver: Muirron the Magician Visibility: individual-or-party PWA status: available Objectives Learn which Achaian inscription or subject Muirron considers valuable. Locate a suitable inscription in a ruin or dungeon. Copy or recover the writing without damaging its context or triggering a magical defense. Deliver the result to Muirron in Eastdale, Ironguard Motte, or on the road. Reward A negotiated payment, translation, or useful magical lore from Muirron’s collection PWA source:

pages.title: Recover the Calico Five
pages.content: Recover the Calico Five Slengar Skullcrusher, sole survivor of the Calico Five, seeks closure for the companions lost during their incursion into Gundgathol. Retrace their expedition, find the site where a deep dragon destroyed the company, and recover the fallen clerics' remains and sacred possessions. Quest ID: recover-calico-five-remains Giver: Slengar Skullcrusher Visibility: party-only PWA status: available Objectives Find Slengar in Khalidheroneth and record his account of the expedition. Retrace the Calico Five's route into Gundgathol. Locate the place where the company encountered the deep dragon. Recover Cheluthim's remains and the sacred possessions of the fallen clerics. Determine whether the deep dragon still threatens the route. Reward To be arranged with Slengar Skullcrusher PWA source:

pages.title: Recover the Men of the Motte Journal
pages.content: Recover the Men of the Motte Journal Quest ID: recover-men-of-the-motte-journal Summary: Find the missing field journal from Muirron Artelba’s adventuring days with the Men of the Motte before its account of a forgotten site is sold, altered, or destroyed. Giver: Muirron the Magician Objectives Learn where Muirron last saw the Men of the Motte journal. Track the journal through collectors, caravaners, or an abandoned cache. Recover the pages without allowing a dangerous site description to circulate. Return the journal to Muirron and determine whether its location is worth investigating. Reward Muirron’s research aid, a spell or antiquarian service, and a share of any safe discovery named in the journal Prerequisites None recorded in the PWA registry. PWA Source

pages.title: Recover the Runic Tablets
pages.content: Recover the Runic Tablets Runic Tablets buried with the Cumerian dead were meant to ward off tomb-robbers, but folk tales claim that reading them brings a curse. Recover one or more tablets for a scholar while surviving whatever safeguards remain in the barrows. Quest ID: recover-barrowmaze-runic-tablets Giver: A scholar or antiquarian in Helix Visibility: individual-or-party PWA status: available Objectives Locate an intact Cumerian burial containing a Runic Tablet. Recover the tablet without destroying its inscriptions. Determine whether the tablet curse is real and how it can be contained. Deliver the tablet to the patron without attracting tomb-robbers or undead. Reward Payment for an intact tablet and expert help with any resulting curse Prerequisites Gated by: investigate-barrowmaze-undead PWA source:

pages.title: Recover the Secret of Silent Diamond
pages.content: Recover the Secret of Silent Diamond Investigate the western Middenmark village of Silent Diamond and learn whether Thoras Goldpanner's legendary fist-sized diamond left a surviving trail or hidden claim. Quest ID: recover-silent-diamond-record Giver: A collector of dwarven mining history Visibility: individual-or-party PWA status: available Objectives Establish what records remain of Thoras Goldpanner's discovery. Determine who knew the diamond's location before Thoras died. Recover the missing record, map, or other proof without provoking a local feud. Reward A negotiated fee for the recovered history, with a finder’s share if the diamond is located PWA source:

pages.title: Reopen the Way to the Gauntwood Galleries
pages.content: Reopen the Way to the Gauntwood Galleries Use the newly surveyed passages beneath the Keep on the Borderlands to identify whether a route can be reopened toward the dwarven Gauntwood Galleries. Quest ID: reopen-gauntwood-way Giver: Citadel Silver's regent Visibility: party-only PWA status: available Objectives Compare the Keep's underground map with dwarven records of the Gauntwood Galleries. Find and clear the first blocked section of the old route. Mark hazards and usable camps for a future dwarven expedition. Reward Dwarven coin, supplies, and a negotiated share of recovered materials Prerequisites Unlocked by: map-kharaz-ankor-entrance PWA source:

pages.title: Restore the Hoskighee Trade Road
pages.content: Restore the Hoskighee Trade Road Help Hoskighee maintain its coal and limestone trade with Helix, Bogtown, Wyrdwood, and Ironguard Motte despite dangers in the Moon Peaks foothills. Quest ID: restore-hoskighee-trade-road Giver: The merchants of Hoskighee Visibility: party-only PWA status: available Objectives Learn which section of the trade road has become unsafe. Escort a shipment or repair the route through the foothills. Identify and resolve the threat disrupting trade. Reward A merchant's payment and a discount on Hoskighee coal or limestone PWA source:

pages.title: Rot in the Grey Company
pages.content: Rot in the Grey Company Radloc Hudson suspects Darkeyes agents are bribing Grey Company guards and compromising Eastdale's caravans and warehouses. Investigate from outside the company, expose the corruption, and identify the Darkeyes mastermind without alerting potentially compromised personnel. Quest ID: rot-grey-company Giver: Radloc Hudson Visibility: party-only PWA status: available Objectives Identify compromised Grey Company guards. Protect a vulnerable shipment or operate a decoy caravan. Trace stolen goods through Eastdale's underground routes. Identify the Darkeyes mastermind without exposing the investigation prematurely. Reward To be negotiated with Radloc Hudson PWA source:

pages.title: Sabotage at Guardians' Rest
pages.content: Sabotage at Guardians' Rest Supplies have been poisoned and gate mechanisms damaged at Guardians' Rest shortly before caravan season. Evidence implicates Mordicar Justhand's household, but appears suspiciously convenient. Quest ID: sabotage-guardians-rest Giver: Father Zistrus Visibility: party-only PWA status: available Objectives Secure the caravan station against further attacks. Identify how the saboteur gained access. Determine who benefits from discrediting Father Zistrus. Prevent the dispute from disrupting trade between Kirkilston and Eastdale. Reward Payment, free resupply, and future lodging at Guardians' Rest PWA source:

pages.title: Scout the Ruins of Thundertree
pages.content: Scout the Ruins of Thundertree Survey the ruins of Thundertree, destroyed by the green dragon Inzeldrin, and determine whether the deeper Netherese ruins beneath the village can be reached safely. Quest ID: scout-thundertree-netherese-ruins Giver: A scholar of Netherese ruins Visibility: party-only PWA status: available Objectives Reach the ruins northeast of Slaytonthorpe. Determine whether Inzeldrin or other threats still occupy the site. Locate an accessible entrance to the deeper Netherese ruins. Return with a report and any non-dangerous evidence of the older settlement. Reward A research fee and payment for recoverable Netherese records PWA source:

pages.title: Search for Benediction Beneath Undalan
pages.content: Search for Benediction Beneath Undalan Investigate the tradition that Benediction, an ancient city older than Undalan, lies in ruins beneath the settlement below Phandalin. Quest ID: descend-beneath-undalan Giver: A historian or treasure-seeker in Phandalin Visibility: party-only PWA status: available Objectives Find reliable evidence for the ruins of Benediction beneath Undalan. Locate a safe route into the buried city. Return with a map, inscription, or other proof of what lies below. Reward Payment for verified discoveries and any safely recovered antiquities PWA source:

pages.title: Secure the Coal Hills Supply Line
pages.content: Secure the Coal Hills Supply Line Quest ID: secure-coalscuttle-supply Summary: Keep the miners of Coalscuttle supplied and their coal shipment moving after a threat interrupts the route from the Coal Hills. Giver: The miners of Coalscuttle Objectives Learn what has interrupted the road between Coalscuttle and its buyers. Escort tools, food, or a coal shipment through the threatened stretch. Discover whether the danger is banditry, a monster, or a rival mining interest. Restore a dependable route without collapsing the camp’s fragile economy. Reward Coal, miners’ pay, and a continuing discount on fuel or metalwork Prerequisites None recorded in the PWA registry. PWA Source

pages.title: Seek the Sealed Gates of Deep Chaymyn
pages.content: Seek the Sealed Gates of Deep Chaymyn Deep Chaymyn is said to be sealed behind massive dwarven bulkheads and powerful wards, yet its inhabitants supposedly have not needed the surface for centuries. Find evidence of the hold’s condition and learn why its gates remain closed. Quest ID: seek-the-deep-chaymyn-gate Giver: A historian of the Northern Reaches or a dwarf seeking news of Deep Chaymyn Visibility: party-only PWA status: available Objectives Gather surviving records or testimony about the hold’s entrances. Reach a sealed gate without provoking the wards or the hold’s defenders. Determine whether Deep Chaymyn is thriving, abandoned, or under an internal threat. Return with proof of the hold’s condition or a message from its inhabitants. Reward Dwarven patronage, historical payment, or a negotiated trade with Deep Chaymyn PWA source:

pages.title: Silence at Ford-at-Isenduin
pages.content: Silence at Ford-at-Isenduin Billworth's promised follow-up work concerns caravans disappearing near Ford-at-Isenduin. Wagons have been found abandoned, but neither cargo nor travelers remain. Quest ID: silence-ford-isenduin Giver: Billworth Turgen Visibility: party-only PWA status: available Objectives Investigate the abandoned wagons. Identify who is controlling the ford. Recover survivors and stolen cargo. Make the crossing safe for future caravans. Reward Negotiable payment from Billworth, plus authorized salvage PWA source:

pages.title: Solve the Mystery of Phultarr's Pool
pages.content: Solve the Mystery of Phultarr's Pool Quest ID: solve-phultarrs-pool Summary: Investigate the inexplicable freshwater lake in the Rauth Desert, called both Demetra’s Tears and Oaxus’ Blood, and learn why it has never run dry. Giver: A desert caravan master or rival priesthood Objectives Reach Phultarr’s Pool and document its water, shores, and nearby ruins or signs. Identify whether the lake is natural, magical, or maintained by a hidden power. Determine what the names Demetra’s Tears and Oaxus’ Blood mean to local travelers. Return with a safe-water route or warning about a danger connected to the pool. Reward Desert guides’ gratitude, a reliable oasis route, and any relic revealed by the investigation Prerequisites None recorded in the PWA registry. PWA Source

pages.title: Stem the Dead from Barrowmaze
pages.content: Stem the Dead from Barrowmaze Undead are emerging from the Cumerian barrows beneath the marsh and reaching the outskirts of Helix and Bogtown. Find the source of the outbreak and reduce the threat before more dead reach settled streets. Quest ID: investigate-barrowmaze-undead Giver: The authorities or temples of Helix and Bogtown Visibility: party-only PWA status: available Objectives Travel to Barrowmaze and identify the routes by which undead are leaving the tombs. Determine what has caused the recent increase in undead activity. Destroy or seal the immediate source of the outbreak. Report which surrounding settlements remain at risk. Reward A negotiated civic or temple payment, plus salvage from cleared tombs PWA source:

pages.title: Test the Guardian Shrine’s Fire
pages.content: Test the Guardian Shrine’s Fire Sir Ardan Hearthward tends a lonely Demetran shrine in the hills, where travelers say the eternal fire burns hotter when danger is near. Visit the shrine, learn what has disturbed its flame, and help Ardan protect those who rely on its shelter. Quest ID: investigate-guardian-shrine-fire Giver: Sir Ardan Hearthward Visibility: individual-or-party PWA status: available Objectives Travel to the shrine and observe the fire’s unusual behavior. Investigate nearby cairns, paths, and signs of orcspawn or other threats. Determine whether the danger is approaching the shrine or only passing through the hills. Help Sir Ardan keep the shrine safe and the eternal flame burning. Reward Sir Ardan’s steadfast aid, shelter on future journeys, and a negotiated shrine blessing PWA source:

pages.title: The Demon Beyond the East Tower
pages.content: The Demon Beyond the East Tower Sixteen years ago, Kelda Rue's failed summoning dragged her master, Thelgarr Blackstaff, into another plane. Search his abandoned laboratory, determine whether he still lives, and prevent the summoned demon from finding a path back into Issenda. Quest ID: demon-beyond-east-tower Giver: Kelda Rue Visibility: party-only PWA status: available Objectives Search Thelgarr Blackstaff's abandoned laboratory. Reconstruct the summoning ritual that opened the planar passage. Locate or safely reopen the passage to the plane that claimed Thelgarr. Rescue Thelgarr, recover proof of his death, or permanently seal the breach. Reward Kelda Rue's magical guidance and access to temple resources PWA source:

pages.title: The Failing Mythalvane
pages.content: The Failing Mythalvane The Mythalvane's magical protection has begun failing unpredictably. Rafell Riverwarden's surviving research points to a buried relay chamber outside Helix. Quest ID: failing-mythalvane Giver: The Seekers' Chapterhouse in Helix Visibility: party-only PWA status: available Objectives Locate the relay chamber. Determine whether the failures result from decay or sabotage. Recover or repair the damaged component. Keep the failing defenses secret from Helix's enemies. Reward Seeker favor and restricted access to their historical records PWA source:

pages.title: The Thirsting Pool
pages.content: The Thirsting Pool Phultarr's Pool, an inexplicable freshwater lake beyond living memory, is shrinking rapidly. Its retreating shoreline has exposed ancient stone steps descending beneath the water. Quest ID: thirsting-pool Giver: Caravan masters crossing the Rauth Desert Visibility: party-only PWA status: available Objectives Determine what is draining the lake. Explore the newly exposed structure. Restore the desert's freshwater supply. Discover whether the pool is Demetra's Tears, Oaxus' Blood, or something older. Reward Recovered relics and the gratitude of desert travelers PWA source:

pages.title: Trace Murfex's Last Journey
pages.content: Trace Murfex's Last Journey Retrace master glassworker Murfex Garrick's final journey toward Threshold. Discover where and how he died, recover his missing work, and determine whether his death was an accident or connected to his experimental glassware. Quest ID: trace-murfex-last-journey Giver: Jelb Garrick and the Garrick family Visibility: individual-or-party PWA status: available Objectives Establish Murfex's intended route and reason for traveling to Threshold. Find witnesses or physical traces from his final journey. Determine the circumstances of Murfex's death. Recover his experimental glassware, notes, or unfinished masterpiece for the Garrick family. Reward To be arranged with the Garrick family PWA source:

pages.title: Trace the Vanished Elven Holds
pages.content: Trace the Vanished Elven Holds Follow Thurgan Newl's rumor that the drow may have been involved in the abandonment of the Glittering Canopy and Aelith-Calaer. Quest ID: trace-vanished-elven-holds Giver: Thurgan Newl Visibility: individual-or-party PWA status: available Objectives Gather testimony about the empty elven sites. Determine whether drow activity around Narinza or Shade points to the vanished holds. Find out whether the abandonment still threatens surface settlements. Reward Not specified in the PWA quest record. PWA source:

pages.title: Uncover the Green Lady’s Secret Logothete
pages.content: Uncover the Green Lady’s Secret Logothete Whispers in Gosterwick describe an unlisted fourth Logothete who hires adventurers to retrieve private acquisitions from Arden Vul. Find the hidden employer, learn what is being sought, and decide whether the arrangement should remain secret. Quest ID: uncover-gosterwick-logothete Giver: A discreet informant at the Yellow Cloak Visibility: individual-or-party PWA status: available Objectives Identify the unlisted Logothete and establish who currently works for them. Learn what item or information Lady Alexia wants recovered from Arden Vul. Determine whether the acquisition is legal, dangerous, or connected to a rival faction. Choose whether to expose the scheme, accept the work, or prevent the acquisition. Reward A confidential payment, access to Gosterwick contacts, or leverage over Lady Alexia PWA source:

pages.title: Unmask the Surface Hand Behind the Toothbreakers
pages.content: Unmask the Surface Hand Behind the Toothbreakers Use Algorn Druff's read of the recovered orders to learn whether a surface faction is directing the Toothbreakers, Red Tusk, and the Deep Friends. Quest ID: unmask-surface-hand Giver: Algorn Druff Visibility: individual-or-party PWA status: available Objectives Compare the two writing styles in the recovered orders. Look for signs of the Basilisk's Claw, Cult of the Dragon, Zhentarim, or a witch-coven connection. Identify the faction or agent using the Toothbreakers as muscle. Reward Not specified in the PWA quest record. PWA source:

pages.title: When the Shrine Fire Burns Hot
pages.content: When the Shrine Fire Burns Hot The eternal flame at Sir Ardan Hearthward's shrine has begun burning unnaturally hot, an omen of danger emerging from deeper in the Blanryde Hills. Follow the warning, rescue those endangered by it, and confront the wilderness threat. Quest ID: shrine-fire-burns-hot Giver: Sir Ardan Hearthward Visibility: party-only PWA status: available Objectives Gather reports of missing travelers and unusual activity. Follow forgotten cairns and old sheep paths into the Blanryde Hills. Find and rescue the missing. Eliminate the wilderness threat or clearly mark its lair. Reward Sir Ardan's aid, friendship, and knowledge of forgotten paths PWA source:

pages.title: Dragonkind
pages.content: fb A race produced by the Visitors experiments, dragons were powerful enough over uncounted millennia to raid large cities of the other races with impunity. Dragons dominated the surface world, claiming vast areas of territory and battling each other for land, mates, and status. The great drakes suffered setbacks only when lesser races mastered magic, and they remain influential today despite the advances of such rabble. See also, Sarrukh.

pages.title: Drow
pages.content: Dark elves who once, many millennia ago, were part of the great throng of surface elves. Sometime in the distant past, a great dispute and schism divided the elves of the surface world. The elves will not speak of it outside of their own race. Those who withdrew to the Underdark eventually became dark elves , able to use faerzress-induced native abilities.

pages.title: Duergar
pages.content: duergar.png Gray Dwarves, sharing common ancestry with Mountain (Shield) Dwarves. Originally, this info lived here. No. Enc: 1 (12d3) ¢ Alignment: Chaotic Evil ¢ Movement: 20' ¢ Armor Class: 6 (or by armor type) ¢ Hit Dice: 4 (typically 23-28 HP), or by level if PC/NPC ¢ BAB +4, or by class and level if any adventurer ¢ Attacks: 2 ¢ Damage: By dual-wielded axes ” 1d6 + STR/magic bonuses ¢ Special: perfect darkvision to 240 feet range ¢ Special: paralysis, phantasms, alchemical poisons, or some types of illusion ¢ Special: +4 to saves vs mind-affecting spells, items, and abilities ¢ Save: as FGT of HD levels, or by PC level if an adventurer ¢ Morale: 10 ¢ Hoard: 6d4 chroma, 3d4+4 royals, 2d4+8 copper (80% it's Red Cuprous , 50% black) Duergar should be treated as Fighters for determining their BAB. They are able to attack twice per round by dual-wielding axes. The second attack is at a -2 to-hit penalty ” but if the first attack hits, the penalty for the second drops to -1. Anytime five or more duergar are found together, one of them will be a leader with 5-7 HD (35-40 HP, and a 70% chance of having arcane or clerical spells. Millenia ago, the duergar were a clan of shield dwarves in the dwarven kingdom of Barakuir, located within the ancient realm of Shanatar. Clan Duergar, which venerated Laduguer as their patron, was an ambitious and powerful clan, believing that they should lead the kingdoms of Shanatar themselves. When they were denied following the Second Spider War, Clan Duergar turned away from the other dwarven clans, paying only lip service to Shanatar's rulers. This proved a mistake when the mind flayers of Oryndoll, seeing the isolation of Barakuir, attacked the realm in about 8100 DR, enslaving or killing most of the population. Most duergar worship Laduguer. During their captivity, which lasted for generations, the mind flayers performed many cruel and unusual experiments on the dwarves. It was during this harsh period of their history that the duergar emerged as a distinct subrace. Eventually, they rose up against their captors and gained their freedom from the mind flayers. Now free, the duergar carved out a new home for themselves beneath the Great Glacier, founding the city of Gracklstugh. The Deepkingdom spread rapidly through the northern reaches of the Underdark, reaching its peak before a war with the quaggoths of Ursandunthar caused it to enter a gradual decline, battling the remnants of the nation and urged on by drow for centuries thereafter. Since their taking of Gundgathol, their numbers are again waxing.

pages.title: Gnome
pages.content: A gnome's energy and enthusiasm for living shines through every inch of his or her tiny body. Gnomes average slightly over 3 feet tall and weigh 40 to 45 pounds. Their tan or brown faces are usually adorned with broad smiles (beneath their prodigious noses), and their bright eyes shine with excitement. Their fair hair has a tendency to stick out in every direction, as if expressing the gnome's insatiable interest in everything around. A gnome's personality is writ large in his or her appearance. A male gnome's beard, in contrast to his wild hair, is kept carefully trimmed but often styled into curious forks or neat points. A gnome's clothing, though usually made in modest earth tones, is elaborately decorated with embroidery, embossing, or gleaming jewels. As far as gnomes are concerned, being alive is a wonderful thing, and they squeeze every ounce of enjoyment out of their three to five centuries of life. Humans might wonder about getting bored over the course of such a long life, and elves take plenty of time to savor the beauties of the world in their long years, but gnomes seem to worry that even with all that time, they can't get in enough of the things they want to do and see. Gnomes speak as if they can't get the thoughts out of their heads fast enough. Even as they offer ideas and opinions on a range of subjects, they still manage to listen carefully to others, adding the appropriate exclamations of surprise and appreciation along the way. Though gnomes love jokes of all kinds, particularly puns and pranks, they're just as dedicated to the more serious tasks they undertake. Many gnomes are skilled engineers, alchemists, tinkers, and inventors. They're willing to make mistakes and laugh at themselves in the process of perfecting what they do, taking bold (sometimes foolhardy) risks and dreaming large. Curious and impulsive, gnomes might take up adventuring as a way to see the world or for the love of exploring. As lovers of gems and other fine items, some gnomes take to adventuring as a quick, if dangerous, path to wealth. Regardless of what spurs them to adventure, gnomes who adopt this way of life eke as much enjoyment out of it as they do out of any other activity they undertake, sometimes to the great annoyance of their adventuring companions. Some sages believe that gnomes are the result of one line of genetic experimentation in Earth's distant past.

pages.title: Human
pages.content: The most numerous of humanoids, not to mention the humanoid race with the lengthiest history on the planet.

pages.title: Lizardfolk
pages.content: Lizardfolk are humanoid saurians of medium size who live is swamps, marshes, and sometimes jungles and subterranean environments. They tend to be extremely insular and xenophobic, and normally are hostile to other humanoid races. A sizeable Lizardfolk community thrives in the Shrieken Mire.

pages.title: Mandrakes
pages.content: mandrake.png Mandrakes are related to Treants, though the origins of both are so ancient that details have been lost ” or at least, so sages believe. Mandrakes are medium-sized creatures that generally stand between sixty and seventy-eight inches tall. They are comprised of extremely dense xylem and phloem covered in a very tough bark, giving them a base AC of 5. They cannot wear armor, but their Dexterity modifier does apply to their armor class. As mandrakes age, they only grow tougher. Some hoary old mandrakes have a base AC or 2, or even 1. However, they are prone to suffer aging deficits in Dexterity. A mandrake grows to adulthood among trees of other types in a forest, achieving full growth and becoming self-aware in three years, at which point it pulls up roots and become mobile, venturing beyond its birthplace, like a bird leaving its nest. Mandrakes may be lawful, chaotic, or evil, but they are always neutral. They live for 1d4+4 centuries plus 3d4 years. Each time they pass another 100-year mark in age, their AC improves by one step. Sedentary mandrakes require one gallon of water weekly, while active ones require three to four gallons. If a mandrake is able to bathe in sunlight at least four hours daily, it can photosynthesize its own food. Adventuring mandrakes who delve into dungeons away from sunlight require a pint of sugar or syrup daily. If they go without adequate water or nourishment, they suffer a cumulative -1 penalty to AC, to-hit rolls, and saving throws every forty-eight hours until remedied. Mandrakes cannot swim. They also cannot drown in water ” though it may take them a long time to make it to shore if lost overboard during a sea- or lake-crossing. Mandrakes suffer only 50% damage from blunt and piercing weapons, and from cold-based attacks. They suffer normal damage from slashing attacks, and +1 per die from axes of all sorts. They are vulnerable to fire, suffering +1 per die rolled. However, they must sustain a minimum of 15 points of fire damage in a single round in order to catch on fire. A mandrake may not be a thief or necromancer. Paladin mandrakes will always prioritize needs of local druids and rangers. Mandrakes deal 1d6 + STR bonus by striking with a limb. They may wield weapons, but never choose to use slashing weapons. They do not require sleep, so therefore adventuring mandrakes make great sentries when their party camps.

pages.title: Mousefolk
pages.content: Mousefolk derive from ill-advised tampering with the genome of home sapiens by the Visitors, hundreds of thousands of years ago. Mousefolk mature from birth to adulthood in about five years. Although about halfling height, they nevertheless have a movement rate of 30' when unencumbered. Generally weighing 50 to 60 pounds, they tend to be lithe. The lifespan of a Mousefolk is 100 to 130 years. Mousefolk are vulnerable to fear effects, such as a dragon's fear aura. Mousefolk, given adequate time, can chew through anything if its hardness is less than that of their teeth. Mousefolk begin play with with traits Excellent Hearing +1 and with All Mouse, No Rodent +1 . A player may opt to have her 1st level Mousefolk character raise this to either +2 or +3. Most classed Mousefolk are Rangers or Paladins, as they tend toward a nobleness of spirit. If using Moldvay saving throws, Mousefolk have the same saves as Halflings.

pages.title: Sarrukh
pages.content: A magically powerful race of saurian humanoids that came about due to breeding experiments in which the Visitors coupled with humans. At some point during the aliens' manipulations, the Sarrukh achieved the ability to sexually reproduce with one another. Eventually, some of the original visitor-human progeny died out, but of those who did not some were further experimented upon using gene-splicing and geomancy and they developed into the first of dragonkind. Sarrukh and Dragonkind dominated Earth for centuries thereafter as co-equal alpha races. It is unclear now in the present day whether dragonkind magically developed the ability to assume humanoid form, or if instead this was at-will transformation made possible by mastery of genetics. Some sages also now speculate that their may still be living Sarrukh who have chosen to assume and permanently maintain dragon form ” perhaps to better observe ongoing experiments they are conducting. And whether any pure-blooded Visitors remain on Earth, one can only guess. A few sages believe the Sarrukh may have been responsible for the establishment of Ss'zuraass'nee. And most scholars agree that the Yuan-ti either descended from, or were created by, the Sarrukh.

pages.title: Turtaqua
pages.content: No. Enc: 1 ¢ Alignment: Chaotic or Neutral ¢ Movement: 20' ¢ Armor Class: 4 (unarmored) ¢ Hit Dice: 6 (or by player-character level) ¢ BAB: +6 or by PC class/level ¢ Attacks: 2 or 1 ¢ Damage: tail-lash 2d4 (exploding) & bite (1d4), or Trample 3d4 (exploding) ¢ Special Defenses: Resistance to cold-based damage ¢ Special Abilities: breathe water ¢ Save: F6, or by PC class/level ¢ Morale: 10 ¢ Hoard: 35% chance per 2 full HD of 1d4 magic items turtaqua.png Turtaqua are hatched. When they emerge from the egg, they weigh sixty to seventy-five pounds and are size Small, have 1+4 HD, AC 7, and a movement rate of 10'. Turtaqua reach adolescence in three years, at which time they weigh 175 to 225 pounds, are size Medium, have 5+4 HD, AC 5, and have movement 15'. Adulthood is reached at five years, at which time Turtaqua are Large creatures weighing 400 to 500 pounds, have 6+ HD, AC 4, and a movement rate of 20'. Turtaqua can assume a bipedal humanoid shape very reminiscent of the Tortle race once daily for up to five minutes per HD or level. While in this form, they weigh only 60% their normal weight and gain an addition 5' movement per round. If this time period elapses and the Turtaqua doesn't have room to resume its usual shape, it suffers 1d4 HP injury and gains a level of exhaustion. This continues once every 12 hours until the turtaqua can revert, or until it dies. Turtaqua can breathe water, remaining submerged for hours. They prefer freshwater but can survive in bogs, fens, and saltwater. When swimming, they gain +10' movement. Every third round of combat (3, 6, etc.), a Turtaqua may opt to charge and trample. They must move in a straight line at least fifteen feet and attack with a +2 Trample bonus to-hit. Struck foes that are medium size or smaller and which weigh less than the turtaqua must succeed at a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone (giving other attackers +4 against that target until it regains its feet). A Trample attack inflicts 1d4 bludgeoning damage for every two whole hit dice or levels possessed by the Turtaqua.

pages.title: Wolfen
pages.content: Description: The Wolfen are a unique race of beings embodying the essence of wolves in humanoid form. They possess a primal connection to the wilderness and have the extraordinary ability to transform seamlessly between humanoid and wolf forms. Wolfen individuals have a strong and muscular build, exuding an aura of power and agility. They possess sharp senses and keen instincts, reflecting their lupine lineage. Enhanced Senses and Abilities: Wolfen possess heightened senses, which are further amplified in their wolf form. Their night vision is exceptionally sharp, allowing them to navigate even the darkest environments with ease. Wolfen possess acute hearing, capable of detecting the faintest sounds. Their sense of smell is incredibly potent, enabling them to track scents over great distances and discern even the subtlest of odors. In their wolf form, Wolfen gain a significant boost to their speed, agility, strength and durability making them formidable hunters and combatants. Transformation Ability: The Wolfen's most remarkable trait is their innate capacity to shift between humanoid and wolf forms at will. When they undergo this transformation, their bodies undergo a profound physical alteration. In their wolf form, they become larger, sporting a powerful and muscular build. Their fur thickens, taking on the colors and patterns of wolves native to their environment. The Wolfen's eyes retain their lupine glow, emanating an intense and piercing gaze. Humanoid Form Advantages: In their humanoid form, Wolfen display certain advantages that differ from their wolf form. They possess a natural affinity for communication and diplomacy, with a heightened ability to understand social dynamics and read emotions. This makes them skilled negotiators and diplomats, capable of navigating complex interactions with finesse. Wolfen are proficient in ranged weaponry, such as bows or throwing weapons, thanks to their precise hand-eye coordination. Additionally, their humanoid form allows them to wear armor and utilize tools with ease, providing them with enhanced protection and versatility in different situations. Wolf Form Advantages: When Wolfen assume their wolf form, they gain physical attributes that surpass their humanoid abilities. Their speed, agility, and strength increase significantly, granting them an advantage in combat and pursuit. Lupins in wolf form possess heightened endurance, enabling them to traverse great distances without tiring. Their acute senses become even more acute, allowing them to track scents with unparalleled accuracy and perceive minute details in their surroundings. Heroic Deeds and Traits: Both forms have their own separate Heroic Deeds and Traits and both sides gain more as per their character's level. The Humanoid form side gains levels in whatever Class they choose to progress in while the Wolf forms side gains racial levels as a Wolf and may only select Wolf Heroic Deeds and traits appropriate for an animal. The exception to this is that both sides share the trait; Enhanced Senses. Like the Thief's archetype trait, Wolfen gain a free 3-points in this trait. Each time they advance a level, this trait increases by one point, even beyond the usual three-point limit for a trait but only on the Wolf Forms side. The Humanoid side of this trait remains capped at +3 or higher if regular trait points are eventually used to raise it passed +3. Wolf Form Changes: Size: increases to large Attributes: All Physical attributes raise to 18 and all Mental Attributes fall to 3. Loses the ability to communicate via language, although may still communicate as an intelligent canine might. Weapons, armor and gear morph into the Wolfen's new form. natural AC 5. Wolf Class Abilities --------------------------- Armor : None (Natural Armor) Weapons : None (Bite Attack) Initial HP : 10 HP Gained : +5 per level Attack Bonus : +1 Attack Bonus Gain : +1 per level Fray Die : 1d4

pages.title: Yuan-ti
pages.content: A race of snake-like humanoids that are distant descendants of the Sarrukh. Sages aren't certain if yuan-ti are direct Sarrukh descendants ” perhaps with some longitudinal genetic mutations ” or if perhaps they resulted from Sarrukh interbreeding with one or more other species.

pages.title: Shadowdim 1
pages.content: Three thousand years after the gods fled, the vast and many lands had only begun to recover from The Disaster. It was exceedingly difficult for sages to track progress in The Recovery, for The Disaster had wiped all details related to its occurrence from collective societal memory and had destroyed any early recordings of its world-spanning impact. All that men knew now was that they had descended from a grander age, from a time in which magic was the lifeblood of society, and the gods no strangers to men. Three hundred years ago, ongoing after-effects of The Disaster included earthquakes and massive cave-ins of prodigious tracks of surface lands into the seemingly bottomless bowels of the Deep Down. When half of the Exarchate of Prolemion suffered this same fate, Rameses Kal-Leon III made an offer too tempting to resist: any brave soul or group who brought a solution to the world's ongoing breakdown back from the World's Bowels would be given archon status; they and all their family would be deeded access to one of the Sky Islands, lord of their own aerial mini-kingdom. This was too rich for Deornoth Stelgaard and his lover, Exodore (ex-oh-DOOR-ray) Swift to pass up, especially given that they were hunted by the Surface authorities. They would undertake risk to life and limb in the Deep Down, and perhaps taste Death — but was that not better than rotting in a dungeon or being hanged? And so, which Entrance to use? Arden, Dwimmer, Great-Barrow, Helix, Thracia? They opted for Arden, for it was the nearest. --- Welcome to Shadowdim: solo-roleplay in the Deep Down... ( --- exodore-headshot.png"Are we entirely certain, sweet love, that this undertaking is supported by both our research and by common sense?" Exodore inquired, large brown eyes studying the mountain before them from beneath her cloak's hood. "For it cannot be a coincidence that the rumored wealth of ancient, lost Vul hasn't been plundered through the centuries. dorn-headshot.png"More than certain, dearest. Not only am I pursued by Lord Imla's guards, but the Gatekeepers seek me for tax evasion. And if those were not jointly motivation enough, the guild remains unconvinced of my innocence in the recent embezzlement." Dorn noted Exie's quick turning of her head at this pronouncement, and he hurried on: "Our vault in Lowshelf was endangered by the recent quakes. I merely relocated funds to a safer location in—" "In one of your hidden caches, in the Catacombs, yes!" she agreed archly. "Did you really think that there was Theo's Chance that Grandmaster Gio—" " Shh! " Dorn shushed Exie, quickly taking her arm and pulling her down beside him where he now squatted in the tall grass. Fifty yards away, three people came up the Dawntrack and approached Arden's Mouth: a sauntering blond youth with a goatee, a woman with a crossbow slung across her back over leathers, and an older man carrying a walking staff. “Great...” Exie breathed. “Now we not only have to flee, but we must avoid being seen by those three.” Exxie slowly released an arrow she’d been about to draw from her quiver. “Or maybe they were sent after us by Giodon.” The two watched as the trio made their way into Arden’s Mouth and disappeared into the mountain. The Dawntrack was empty again. Dorn and Exie could hear the waterfall from where it coursed thunderously just beyond sight, perhaps a couple radians northward around the mountain. After ten minutes the two rose and began moving toward the mountain. “I wouldn’t worry too much about those three,” Dorn said, and he grinned. --- Three minutes later, the duo were inside the mountain and a few dozen yards down the gullet, as Dorn chose to think of it. Arden's Mouth, Arden's Gullet. He grinned. He raised his unsheathed longsword as a shadow advanced upon him from down-tunnel, then saw from the faint lichen illumination that is was only Exie, coming back from silently scouting ahead. She signaled to Dorn in the barely adequate illumination, using the sign language particular to the Black Fists mercenaries: nearby ahead, nobody spotted but crosses a boundary. The descent steepens; hazards include razor-rock and slick stone. Dorn nodded his understanding and gestured for Exie to lead onward. They each wore the tough but supple leather boots of the guilders, and their equipment — though mundane — was of high quality workmanship. It was generally believed, and this seemed born out by lived experience, that most magic across the surface of Issenda had been undone by The Disaster. That was the supposition. There were notable exceptions. Dorn was nearly certain that Guildmaster Giodon Thales wore an enchanted cloak that somehow embellished the man's already prodigious talents. A couple dozen yards further down the Gullet, the descent steepened, and Exie pointed out scratch marks on the walls of the tunnel. The graven sigils were ancient, and neither man nor woman could decipher them. But what was known from the reports of previous expeditions — when someone actually returned from one, which wasn't often — was that these markings indicated a boundary between the surface lands and ... elsewhere . Crossing the boundary, they both felt it: a deepening of the brooding darkness, a further drop in temperature, and a screaming recognition in the hindbrain that one was now in Dangerous Territory. The darkness was now so thick that Exie reluctantly lit a hooded lantern. She adjusted it so that it produced a thin arc of light directly ahead of her, a beam that she played upon the floor of the tunnel as she carefully picked a way forward, ever vigilante for slippery stretches of stone and razor-rock, a combination that had been the undoing of many who had plumbed these depths over the centuries. "I hate the necessity," she said quietly, raising the lantern momentarily to indicate her meaning. "The light will make us a target, but there's nothing to be done about it." Dorn grunted, cutting off a length of jerky with his belt knife and passing it to Exie. "Legends tell of a now extinct species that could see perfectly well in darkness. Aelves they were called. They were descendants of The Visitors." "And who were they ?" asked Exie. "A race that visited Issenda in the very distant past." He retrieved a block of cheese from his pack, cut each of them a chunk of it. "Oh, so they were the ones who left the portals, such as the Prayer Gate of Wynthia, then?" Dorn chewed, swallowed, then drank deeply from a wineskin before passing it to Exie. "Perhaps," he answered, "or maybe they used some other means of coming to our world, a great galleon that plied the void between worlds. That's what Ender of the Collegium believed." "Ender the Heretic," Exie said, and finished off the wine, discarding the now empty skin amid a pile of shale on the right hand side of the tunnel. "You surely don't believe his theory." Dorn shrugged. "I've not studied at the Collegium, but I'd not presume to know better than someone who had . Perhaps someday I'll get the opportunity." What he didn't say, but what they both were thinking, was that it was of questionable likelihood whether they either one would get much of a future. If the dangers of the Deep Down didn't take their lives, a return to the Surface likely would — unless of course they could outlive both Imla Falsta and Giodon Thales. Dorn stroked the stubble on his chin, thinking, then turned to Exie. "Here's what we're gonna do..." --- Half an hour later, Dorn stood in the center of a large cavern that is riddled with stalagtites and stalagmites, some of which joined to form eerily flowing stone pillars. He held a torch aloft. He only raised his voice a little, but his words carried well in the echoing chamber. "You may as well come on out. I saw you entering Arden's Mouth, and I know you're seeking me. Let us therefore palaver. There is one of me and three of you, and as you can see my sword is sheathed." sd-session1-img2.webp A baritone voice from somewhere to Dorn's left: "Hail, Dorn. Father Zorvin of Cromm. I am accompanied by Jorun Fielenghast, nephew to Lord Falsta, and Vida Moinder, guardswoman of the Prelm Gatekeepers. We bear a court summons demanding that you surrender yourself to our custody and return with us to the city." "Oh?" Dorn's voice clearly conveyed he had raised an eyebrow at this. "Well then, Cromm care for and keep you, Father." "Cromm care for and keep you," came the priest's reply. "Will you surrender yourself peacefully? If you will do so, I will stand surety to your fair handling and will see to it that you have legal representation." "Show yourself, priest. Let us converse like men, face to face." A portly, gray-robed man with a tonsured pate and graying hair emerged from behind a stone column where the slow deposits of geologic time had conspired to form a natural pillar. He approached and handed Dorn a scroll. "I believe you'll see everything is in order, if you will read the summons." Dorn extended a hand. "Hold my torch, would you?" Then he unfurled the scroll and began reading: Deornoth Stelgard, inasmuch as considerable coinage has gone missing from a secure holding of the Black Fists Guild, and given that you additionally are changed with evasion of taxes, you are ordered on the authority of Devis Prelm to present yourself before the magistrate at City Hall on Conqueror's Street, City of Prelm, forthwith. " Dorn tsk-tsked , rolled up the scroll, and handed it back to Father Zorvin. "You have the wrong man. I don't know who Deornoth Stelg a rd is, but I am Deornorth Stelga a rd, with two consecutive letter 'a's in my surname. I'm sure that you know that this error makes this summons not legally binding. But I must confess to curiosity: how did you predict that I would be entering Arden's Mouth today, for I told no one my intention?" The priest was still apparently processing Dorn's claim that the summons wasn't legally binding. "Well, I... well, you see..." Out from behind a rather broad stalagmite stepped the young man, hair blond, goatee neatly trimmed and coming to a ridiculous point below his chin. He worked something he was carrying, and a window of light bloomed from his bullseye lantern which had heretofore been shuttered. "Allow me to introduce myself. I am—" "—Lord Falsta's nephew, yes — the priest already said so," Dorn interrupted. "Well, in that case, you'll know that I am—" "— not yet a barrister, if the priest's description was accurate. As I understand it, you are in training , a mere student of legalities and therefore unable to act as an officer of the court. You—" "—Now see here!" huffed the young man. "My father is Lord Imla Falsta and you would do well to be careful in how—" " Perhaps you are," Dorn interrupted, "but was he married to your mother when you were conceived? If not, that would make you a bastard, and only a partially educated bastard at that. Why, I would hazard to guess that—" "Vida, arrest this man now ! On my father's authority!" The youth's voice had grown shrill, and the lantern jangled metallically in his now shaking hand. A woman approached from elsewhere in the cavern, not yet within the torch or lantern's light, and Jorun — angry eyes locked on Dorn — instructed her: "Put him in irons, and be none too gentle in so doi—" The youth's words abruptly cut off, as a dagger's point pressed to the spot where the back of the skull joins the neck. "Vida is indisposed at the moment," Exie explained, "and you are two inches of steel away from an untimely death." She paused for a moment, then: "And you apparently need medical attention for incontinence, but that isn't your most immediate concern," she said. Urine continued to dribble onto one of the dandy's boots, then pooled on the cavern floor. --- A couple of hours later, a trio sat warming themselves at a small, unadorned metallic cube some six inches on a side. Most enchantments, at least on the Surface, had been broken by The Disaster, but various pieces of tech left by some Visitors in the distant past still worked. What Dorn appreciated the most about this small device was that it produced heat without simultaneously emitting light. Dorn's torch had long since burned out, but they had the bullseye lantern, thanks to Jorun. Exie laughed, "I can't believe how smoothly that went; how did you manage it, Zorvin?" "Ah, it was easily done. The Gatekeepers merely do what they are told, and have raised lack of curiosity into an art form. And young dandies like him ... well, they're far too absorbed in their daydreams of climbing the social ladder to piece things together. Father Sovrast was so appreciative when I offered to cover his shift at the temple. He blessed me for offering, and that was that. I was just the right man in the right place, when this was all put into motion." Faintly visible in the mostly shuttered lantern's illumination, Exie shook her head in amusement. "But now you've gone and done it. You'll have made an enemy of Lord Imla, and that isn't nothing..." "To be truthful, I've been growing more and more disaffected with the politics of the temple, its collusion with the government. I was ready for a change. And there are matters of both history and faith I would investigate here in the Deep Down. Besides, the other half of the Exarchate is liable to fall off anytime. It's a good time to be leaving Prelm." Dorn clapped the priest on the shoulder. "We're glad to have you. You're sure the guardswoman will be all right?"
